slots.label: Air Fryer Chickpeas
slots.info:
Snack · Vegetarian • 20 mins
Crunchy, smoky roasted chickpeas.
158 kcal · 6g protein · 19g carbs · 7g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 can chickpeas, drained
• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 1 tsp smoked paprika
• 1/2 tsp garlic powder

Steps:
1. Pat the chickpeas very dry.
2. Toss with oil, paprika, garlic powder and salt.
3. Air fry at 390°F for 15 minutes (or bake at 425°F for 25), shaking halfway.

slots.label: Apple Pie Yogurt Parfait
slots.info:
Breakfast · Vegetarian • 10 mins
Warm cinnamon apples layered with yogurt and granola.
390 kcal · 23g protein · 58g carbs · 9g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 apples, diced
• 1 tsp butter
• 1 tsp cinnamon
• 1 tbsp maple syrup
• 1 1/2 cups plain Greek yogurt
• 1/2 cup granola

Steps:
1. Cook the apples in butter with cinnamon and maple syrup for 5 minutes until soft.
2. Layer yogurt, apples and granola in two glasses.

slots.id: recipe:Apple Slices with Peanut Butter Dip
slots.label: Apple Slices with Peanut Butter Dip
slots.info:
Snack · Balanced • 5 mins
Sweet-salty and satisfying.
257 kcal · 8g protein · 34g carbs · 13g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 apples, sliced
• 3 tbsp peanut butter
• 2 tbsp plain Greek yogurt
• 1 tsp honey
• 1/2 tsp cinnamon

Steps:
1. Whisk the peanut butter, yogurt, honey and cinnamon until smooth.
2. Serve with apple slices.
slots.q: Apple Slices with Peanut Butter Dip recipe

slots.label: Asian Chicken Lettuce Wraps
slots.info:
Lunch · High Protein • 20 mins
Like the restaurant favorite: savory ground chicken in crisp lettuce cups.
332 kcal · 33g protein · 19g carbs · 14g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 lb ground turkey
• 1 can water chestnuts, chopped
• 3 garlic cloves, minced
• 1 tbsp fresh ginger, grated
• 3 tbsp hoisin
• 2 tbsp soy sauce
• 1 tsp sesame oil
• 2 green onions, sliced
• 1 head butter lettuce

Steps:
1. Brown the turkey in a skillet over medium-high, breaking it up, 6–7 minutes.
2. Add the garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute.
3. Stir in the water chestnuts, hoisin, soy sauce and sesame oil; cook 2 minutes.
4. Spoon into lettuce leaves and top with green onions.

slots.label: Avocado Toast with Jammy Eggs
slots.info:
Breakfast · Vegetarian • 15 mins
Smashed avocado on toasted sourdough with soft-boiled eggs and chili flakes.
422 kcal · 22g protein · 34g carbs · 23g fat

Ingredients:
• 4 large eggs
• 4 slices sourdough
• 1 avocado
• 1 tsp lemon juice
• 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes
• Salt and pepper

Steps:
1. Bring a pot of water to a boil. Lower in the eggs and cook 7 minutes, then move to ice water for 2 minutes and peel.
2. Toast the bread.
3. Mash the avocado with lemon juice, salt and pepper.
4. Spread on the toast, top with halved eggs, and finish with red pepper flakes.
slots.q: Avocado Toast with Jammy Eggs recipe

slots.label: BBQ Chicken Quesadillas
slots.info:
Lunch · High Protein • 20 mins
Smoky shredded chicken, BBQ sauce and melty cheese.
595 kcal · 51g protein · 37g carbs · 26g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 1/2 cups shredded chicken
• 1/4 cup bbq sauce
• 1 cup shredded cheddar
• 1/4 red onion, thinly sliced
• 2 flour tortillas
• 2 tbsp cilantro

Steps:
1. Toss the chicken with BBQ sauce.
2. Cover half of each tortilla with cheese, chicken, onion and cilantro; fold.
3. Cook in a dry skillet over medium 3 minutes per side until crisp and melted.
4. Cut into wedges.

slots.label: BBQ Pulled Chicken Sandwiches
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 30 mins
Tangy shredded chicken on soft buns with slaw.
495 kcal · 44g protein · 49g carbs · 12g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 1/2 lb chicken breast
• 3/4 cup bbq sauce
• 1/2 cup chicken broth
• 4 brioche buns
• 2 cups coleslaw mix
• 2 tbsp mayo
• 1 tsp apple cider vinegar

Steps:
1. Simmer the chicken in the broth, covered, 18 minutes. Shred.
2. Stir in the BBQ sauce and simmer 3 minutes.
3. Toss the slaw with mayo and vinegar.
4. Pile chicken and slaw on the buns.

slots.label: Bacon-Wrapped Chicken
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 35 mins
Juicy chicken breasts wrapped in bacon with roasted green beans.
420 kcal · 59g protein · 8g carbs · 16g fat

Ingredients:
• 4 chicken breasts
• 8 slices bacon
• 1 tsp garlic powder
• 1 tsp smoked paprika
• 1 lb green beans
• 1 tbsp olive oil

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 400°F.
2. Season the chicken and wrap each in 2 slices of bacon.
3. Roast with the green beans (tossed in oil) on a sheet pan 25 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F.

slots.label: Bagel Breakfast Sandwich
slots.info:
Breakfast · High Protein • 10 mins
Egg, cheese and Canadian bacon on a toasted everything bagel.
501 kcal · 31g protein · 49g carbs · 19g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 bagels
• 3 large eggs
• 4 slices Canadian bacon
• 2 slices cheddar
• 1 tsp butter

Steps:
1. Toast the bagels.
2. Warm the Canadian bacon in a skillet 1 minute per side; remove.
3. Melt the butter, pour in the beaten eggs and cook as a thin omelet. Fold into two squares.
4. Stack egg, cheese and Canadian bacon on each bagel.

slots.label: Baked Lemon Dill Salmon
slots.info:
Dinner · Omega-3 • 20 mins
Tender baked salmon fillet with fresh dill.
380 kcal · 34g protein · 2g carbs · 26g fat

Ingredients:
• 6 oz salmon fillet
• Fresh dill
• Lemon slices
• 1 tbsp olive oil

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 400°F and line a small pan with foil.
2. Set the salmon skin-side down, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt and pepper.
3. Lay lemon slices and dill on top.
4. Bake 12–15 minutes until the salmon flakes easily. Serve with rice or a salad.

slots.label: Baked Mac and Cheese
slots.info:
Dinner · Vegetarian • 40 mins
Creamy, crispy-topped, from scratch.
616 kcal · 27g protein · 70g carbs · 25g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 lb elbow pasta
• 3 tbsp butter
• 3 tbsp all-purpose flour

• 1/2 cup panko

slots.label: Baked Oatmeal Cups
slots.info:
Breakfast · Meal Prep • 30 mins
Soft oatmeal "muffins" with blueberries — reheat and go.
259 kcal · 9g protein · 46g carbs · 5g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 1/2 cups rolled oats
• 2 bananas, mashed
• 2 large eggs
• 1 1/4 cups milk
• 1/4 cup maple syrup
• 1 tsp baking powder
• 1 tsp cinnamon
• 1 cup blueberries

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 350°F and grease a 12-cup muffin tin.
2. Mix the bananas, eggs, milk and maple syrup. Stir in the oats, baking powder and cinnamon.
3. Fold in the blueberries and divide among the cups.
4. Bake 22–25 minutes until set. Two cups per serving.

slots.label: Baked Ziti
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 45 mins
Cheesy baked pasta with ricotta and Italian sausage.
710 kcal · 36g protein · 70g carbs · 31g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 lb penne
• 1 lb italian sausage
• 1 jar marinara
• 1 cup ricotta
• 1 1/2 cups mozzarella
• 1/4 cup parmesan

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 375°F. Cook the pasta 2 minutes less than the package says.
2. Brown the sausage, then stir in the marinara.
3. Toss the pasta with the sauce and dollops of ricotta; spread in a 9x13 dish.
4. Top with mozzarella and parmesan and bake 20 minutes until bubbly.

slots.label: Banana Bread Baked Oatmeal
slots.info:
Breakfast · Comfort Food • 40 mins
Tastes like banana bread, slices like oatmeal bars.
374 kcal · 12g protein · 61g carbs · 11g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 cups rolled oats
• 3 bananas, mashed
• 1 1/2 cups milk
• 1 large egg
• 2 tbsp maple syrup
• 1 tsp baking powder
• 1 tsp cinnamon
• 1/4 cup chopped walnuts

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 375°F and grease an 8x8 pan.
2. Mix the bananas, milk, egg and maple syrup.
3. Stir in the oats, baking powder and cinnamon; pour into the pan and top with walnuts.
4. Bake 30–35 minutes until golden and set.

slots.label: Banana Oat Cookies
slots.info:
Snack · Vegetarian • 20 mins
Three-ingredient-style soft cookies with chocolate chips.
209 kcal · 6g protein · 29g carbs · 9g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 bananas, mashed
• 1 1/2 cups rolled oats
• 1/4 cup peanut butter
• 1/4 cup chocolate chips
• 1/2 tsp cinnamon

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 350°F.
2. Mix everything together.
3. Scoop 12 mounds onto a lined sheet and flatten slightly.
4. Bake 14 minutes. Two cookies per serving.

slots.label: Banana Split Yogurt Bowl
slots.info:
Snack · Balanced • 5 mins
All the fun of a banana split, made with yogurt.
349 kcal · 23g protein · 50g carbs · 9g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 banana, split
• 3/4 cup plain Greek yogurt
• 1/4 cup strawberries
• 1/4 cup pineapple
• 1 tbsp mini chocolate chips
• 1 tbsp chopped peanuts

Steps:
1. Lay the banana halves in a bowl.
2. Spoon the yogurt between them.
3. Top with fruit, chocolate chips and peanuts.

slots.label: Beef & Bean Chili
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 50 mins
Thick, hearty chili that's even better the next day.
478 kcal · 43g protein · 33g carbs · 19g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 lb lean ground beef
• 1 onion, diced
• 1 bell pepper, diced
• 3 garlic cloves
• 2 cans kidney beans, drained
• 1 can crushed tomatoes
• 1 can diced tomatoes
• 2 tbsp chili powder
• 1 tsp cumin

• 1/2 cup shredded cheddar

Steps:
1. Brown the beef with the onion and pepper 10 minutes; drain.
2. Add the garlic, chili powder and cumin for 1 minute.

4. Serve topped with cheddar.

slots.label: Beef & Broccoli Meal Prep
slots.info:

Takeout favorite portioned for the week.

• 1/3 cup soy sauce

Steps:
1. Whisk soy sauce, honey, cornstarch, garlic and 1/3 cup water.
2. Sear the beef in the oil in batches; remove.
3. Steam the broccoli in the pan 3 minutes. Return beef and sauce; simmer 1 minute.
4. Divide with rice into 4 containers.

slots.label: Beef & Broccoli Rice Bowls

• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 3 cups cooked rice

Steps:
1. Whisk the soy sauce, honey, cornstarch, garlic, ginger and 1/3 cup water.
2. Sear the beef in the oil in batches, 2 minutes; remove.
3. Steam-fry the broccoli with a splash of water 3 minutes.
4. Return the beef, add the sauce and simmer 1 minute until glossy. Serve over rice.

slots.label: Beef Kebab Rice Plates

• 1/2 cup plain Greek yogurt

• 1 tomato

Steps:
1. Cook the rice.

• 1/2 cup sour cream

Steps:
1. Sear the beef in the butter in batches; remove.
2. Cook the onion and mushrooms 7 minutes. Add garlic and flour for 1 minute.

slots.label: Beef Tacos

• 1/2 cup salsa
• 1/4 cup sour cream

Steps:
1. Brown the beef 7 minutes and drain.

slots.label: Berry Blast Smoothie

Ingredients:

1. Blend everything until smooth.

slots.label: Biscuits & Sausage Gravy (Lighter)

Steps:
1. Brown the sausage in a skillet, breaking it up.
2. Sprinkle the flour over and stir 1 minute.
3. Slowly pour in the milk, stirring, and simmer 5 minutes until thick. Season with pepper.
4. Toast the muffins and spoon the gravy over.

slots.label: Black Bean & Corn Quinoa Salad
slots.info:

Zesty make-ahead salad that gets better overnight.

Ingredients:
• 1 cup quinoa
• 1 can black beans
• 1 cup corn
• 1 bell pepper
• 1/4 red onion
• 1/4 cup cilantro
• 2 tbsp olive oil
• 2 limes
• 1 tsp cumin

Steps:
1. Cook the quinoa and cool.

3. Toss everything together. Keeps 5 days.

slots.label: Black Bean Burgers

• 1 large egg
• 1/2 cup corn

• 1/2 avocado

Steps:
1. Pat the beans dry and mash about 3/4 of them, leaving some whole.

slots.label: Blackened Salmon Tacos

Steps:

slots.label: Breakfast Egg Muffins

1. Heat the oven to 350°F and grease a 12-cup muffin tin.

slots.label: Breakfast Fried Rice

1. Cook the bacon until crisp in a large skillet.

slots.label: Breakfast Hash with Sausage

1. Microwave the diced potatoes covered for 5 minutes to par-cook.
2. Brown the sausage in a large skillet; remove.
3. Add the oil and potatoes; cook undisturbed 5 minutes, then stir and cook 5 more until crisp.

1. Heat the oven to 450°F. Stretch the dough on an oiled sheet pan.
2. Bake the crust 6 minutes.

1. Heat the oven to 375°F.

1. Toss the chicken with buffalo sauce.

Steps:

2. Toss the romaine with dressing and parmesan.
3. Fill the tortillas with salad and chicken, fold in the ends and roll.
4. Cut in half on the diagonal.

slots.label: Chicken Enchilada Soup
slots.info:
Lunch · High Protein • 30 mins
All the enchilada flavor in a creamy, cheesy soup.
468 kcal · 40g protein · 34g carbs · 19g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 lb chicken breast
• 3 cups chicken broth
• 1 can diced tomatoes
• 1 can black beans, drained
• 1/2 onion, diced
• 1 tbsp chili powder
• 4 oz cream cheese
• 1/2 cup shredded cheddar
• 1 cup tortilla chips

Steps:
1. Simmer the chicken, broth, tomatoes, onion and chili powder 18 minutes.
2. Shred the chicken and return it with the beans.
3. Stir in the cream cheese and cheddar until melted.
4. Serve with crushed chips.

slots.label: Chicken Enchiladas
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 45 mins
Shredded chicken rolled in tortillas with red sauce and cheese.
484 kcal · 41g protein · 36g carbs · 19g fat

Ingredients:
• 3 cups shredded chicken
• 10 corn tortillas
• 2 cups enchilada sauce
• 1 1/2 cups shredded cheddar
• 1/2 cup black beans
• 1/4 cup sour cream

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 375°F.
2. Mix the chicken, beans, 1/2 cup sauce and half the cheese.
3. Warm the tortillas, fill, roll and place seam-down in a dish.
4. Pour over the remaining sauce and cheese. Bake 20 minutes. Top with sour cream.

slots.label: Chicken Fajita Rice Bowls Prep
slots.info:
EZ Prep · High Protein • 30 mins
Fajita chicken and peppers over cilantro-lime rice.
530 kcal · 44g protein · 65g carbs · 9g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 1/2 lb chicken breast
• 3 bell peppers
• 1 onion
• 2 tbsp taco seasoning
• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 1 1/2 cups rice
• 1 lime

Steps:
1. Cook the rice; stir in lime juice.
2. Roast the sliced chicken, peppers and onion with oil and seasoning at 425°F for 20 minutes.
3. Divide into 4 containers.
slots.q: Chicken Fajita Rice Bowls Prep recipe

slots.label: Chicken Fried Rice
slots.info:
Lunch · High Protein • 20 mins
Better than takeout and uses leftover rice.
514 kcal · 39g protein · 61g carbs · 11g fat

Ingredients:
• 3 cups cooked rice
• 12 oz chicken breast, diced
• 2 large eggs
• 1 cup frozen peas
• 1 carrot, diced
• 3 tbsp soy sauce
• 1 tbsp sesame oil
• 2 green onions

Steps:
1. Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet. Cook the chicken 5 minutes until done; remove.
2. Cook the carrot and peas 3 minutes. Push aside and scramble the eggs.
3. Add the rice and chicken, then soy sauce. Stir-fry 3 minutes until hot.
4. Top with green onions.

slots.label: Chicken Gyro Bowls
slots.info:
Lunch · High Protein • 30 mins
Marinated chicken, rice, cucumber and tzatziki.
634 kcal · 36g protein · 60g carbs · 28g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 lb chicken thighs
• 1 cup basmati rice
• 1/2 cup tzatziki
• 1 cucumber, diced
• 1 tomato, diced
• 1/4 red onion
• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 1 lemon
• 1 tsp oregano
• 1 tsp garlic powder

Steps:
1. Marinate the chicken with oil, lemon juice, oregano, garlic powder and salt for 10 minutes.
2. Cook the rice.
3. Sear the chicken 5–6 minutes per side; rest and slice.
4. Build bowls with rice, chicken, vegetables and tzatziki.

slots.label: Chicken Marsala-Style Mushroom Chicken
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 30 mins
Seared chicken in a savory mushroom pan sauce.
289 kcal · 41g protein · 6g carbs · 11g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 1/2 lb chicken breast, thin cutlets
• 2 tbsp all-purpose flour
• 2 tbsp butter
• 8 oz mushrooms, sliced
• 2 garlic cloves
• 1 cup chicken broth
• 1 tbsp balsamic
• 2 tbsp parsley

Steps:
1. Dredge the chicken in flour; sear in 1 tbsp butter 3–4 minutes per side. Remove.
2. Cook the mushrooms in the remaining butter 6 minutes; add garlic.
3. Add broth and balsamic and simmer 4 minutes until reduced by half.
4. Return the chicken to warm through. Finish with parsley.

slots.id: recipe:Chicken Meal Prep Bowls with Rice & Broccoli
slots.label: Chicken Meal Prep Bowls with Rice & Broccoli
slots.info:
EZ Prep · High Protein • 35 mins
The classic five-day prep — seasoned chicken, rice and broccoli.
621 kcal · 59g protein · 66g carbs · 12g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 1/2 lb chicken breast
• 2 cups jasmine rice
• 5 cups broccoli florets
• 2 tbsp olive oil
• 1 tbsp garlic powder
• 1 tbsp paprika
• 1 tsp italian seasoning

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 425°F. Cook the rice.
2. Toss the chicken with half the oil and the spices; bake on a sheet pan 18–22 minutes until 165°F.
3. Toss the broccoli with the remaining oil and roast 15 minutes.
4. Slice the chicken and divide everything among 5 containers. Keeps 4–5 days.
slots.q: Chicken Meal Prep Bowls with Rice & Broccoli recipe

slots.label: Chicken Noodle Soup
slots.info:
Lunch · High Protein • 40 mins
Homemade and cozy — ready in under an hour.
403 kcal · 35g protein · 46g carbs · 8g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 lb chicken breast
• 6 cups chicken broth
• 2 carrots, sliced
• 2 celery stalks, sliced
• 1 onion, diced
• 3 garlic cloves, minced
• 2 cups egg noodles
• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 1 tsp thyme

Steps:
1. Heat the oil in a pot and cook the onion, carrots and celery 6 minutes.
2. Add the garlic and thyme for 30 seconds, then the broth and whole chicken breasts. Simmer 15 minutes.
3. Remove the chicken, shred it, and return to the pot.
4. Add the noodles and simmer 7 minutes until tender. Season with salt and pepper.

slots.label: Chicken Parmesan
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 40 mins
Crispy breaded chicken under marinara and melted mozzarella.
772 kcal · 73g protein · 62g carbs · 24g fat

Ingredients:
• 4 chicken breasts, pounded thin
• 1 cup panko
• 1/3 cup parmesan
• 1 large egg
• 1 1/2 cups marinara
• 1 cup mozzarella
• 2 tbsp olive oil
• 8 oz spaghetti

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 425°F.
2. Dip the chicken in beaten egg, then the panko mixed with parmesan.
3. Brown in the oil 3 minutes per side, then move to a baking dish.
4. Spoon marinara over and top with mozzarella. Bake 15 minutes.
5. Serve with spaghetti and extra sauce.

slots.label: Chicken Pesto Panini
slots.info:
Lunch · High Protein • 15 mins
Pesto, mozzarella and roasted red peppers pressed until crispy.
500 kcal · 49g protein · 29g carbs · 20g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 1/2 cups shredded chicken
• 4 slices sourdough
• 2 tbsp pesto
• 1/2 cup mozzarella
• 1/3 cup roasted red peppers
• 1 tsp olive oil

Steps:
1. Spread pesto on two bread slices.
2. Layer chicken, mozzarella and red peppers; top with the remaining bread.
3. Brush the outsides with oil and cook in a skillet, pressing with a heavy pan, 3 minutes per side.

slots.label: Chicken Pot Pie Skillet
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 40 mins
Creamy chicken and vegetables under biscuits.
377 kcal · 30g protein · 31g carbs · 14g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 cups shredded chicken
• 2 cups frozen mixed vegetables
• 3 tbsp butter
• 1/4 cup all-purpose flour
• 2 cups chicken broth
• 1/2 cup milk
• 1 cup baking mix
• 1/3 cup milk

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 400°F.
2. Melt the butter in an oven-safe skillet, whisk in the flour 1 minute, then the broth and 1/2 cup milk. Simmer until thick.
3. Stir in the chicken and vegetables.
4. Mix the baking mix with 1/3 cup milk and drop spoonfuls on top. Bake 18–20 minutes.

slots.label: Chicken Quesadilla Casserole
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 35 mins
Layered tortillas, chicken, beans and cheese baked until bubbly.
544 kcal · 46g protein · 39g carbs · 22g fat

Ingredients:
• 3 cups shredded chicken
• 5 flour tortillas
• 1 can black beans, drained
• 1 cup salsa
• 2 cups shredded cheddar
• 1 tsp cumin

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 375°F.
2. Mix the chicken, beans, salsa and cumin.
3. Layer tortillas, filling and cheese in a round dish, ending with cheese.
4. Bake 20 minutes. Cut into wedges.

slots.label: Chicken Ramen Upgrade
slots.info:
Lunch · High Protein • 15 mins
Instant-style ramen made real with chicken, egg and spinach.
662 kcal · 47g protein · 89g carbs · 12g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 ramen noodles packs
• 4 cups chicken broth
• 1 cup shredded chicken
• 2 large eggs
• 2 cups spinach
• 1 tbsp soy sauce
• 1 tsp sesame oil
• 2 green onions

Steps:
1. Boil the eggs 7 minutes, then cool and peel.
2. Bring the broth, soy sauce and sesame oil to a simmer. Add the noodles (skip the seasoning packet) and cook 3 minutes.
3. Stir in the chicken and spinach until warmed.
4. Divide into bowls and top with halved eggs and green onions.

slots.label: Chicken Salad Croissant-Style Sandwiches
slots.info:
Lunch · High Protein • 15 mins
Greek yogurt chicken salad with grapes and celery on soft buns.
554 kcal · 46g protein · 57g carbs · 18g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 cups shredded chicken
• 1/3 cup plain Greek yogurt
• 2 tbsp mayo
• 1 cup grapes, halved
• 1 celery stalk, diced
• 2 tbsp chopped pecans
• 3 brioche buns
• 3 lettuce leaves

Steps:
1. Stir the yogurt, mayo, salt and pepper together.
2. Fold in the chicken, grapes, celery and pecans.
3. Pile onto the buns with lettuce.

slots.label: Chicken Sausage Pasta Bake Prep
slots.info:
EZ Prep · Comfort Food • 40 mins
Freezer-friendly pasta bake with peppers and spinach.
514 kcal · 27g protein · 70g carbs · 13g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 lb penne
• 12 oz chicken sausage
• 1 jar marinara
• 2 cups spinach
• 1 bell pepper
• 1 1/2 cups mozzarella

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 375°F. Cook pasta 2 minutes short.
2. Brown the sausage with the pepper; stir in marinara and spinach.
3. Toss with pasta, top with mozzarella and bake 20 minutes.
4. Cool and portion.
slots.q: Chicken Sausage Pasta Bake Prep recipe

slots.label: Chicken Shawarma Wraps
slots.info:
Lunch · High Protein • 30 mins
Warm-spiced chicken with garlic sauce and pickled onions.
417 kcal · 39g protein · 39g carbs · 11g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 lb chicken thighs
• 3 flatbreads
• 1/3 cup plain Greek yogurt
• 1 garlic clove, grated
• 1 tsp cumin
• 1 tsp paprika
• 1/2 tsp turmeric
• 1 lemon
• 1 tomato
• 1/4 red onion

Steps:
1. Toss the chicken with cumin, paprika, turmeric, half the lemon juice and salt.
2. Sear 5–6 minutes per side; rest and slice.
3. Mix the yogurt, garlic and remaining lemon juice.
4. Fill the flatbreads with chicken, tomato, onion and garlic sauce.

slots.label: Chicken Stir-Fry
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 25 mins
Crisp vegetables and chicken in a simple savory sauce.
474 kcal · 46g protein · 50g carbs · 9g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 1/2 lb chicken breast, sliced
• 4 cups stir-fry vegetables
• 1/4 cup soy sauce
• 1 tbsp honey
• 1 tbsp cornstarch
• 2 garlic cloves
• 1 tsp fresh ginger
• 1 tbsp sesame oil
• 3 cups cooked rice

Steps:
1. Whisk soy sauce, honey, cornstarch, garlic, ginger and 1/3 cup water.
2. Stir-fry the chicken in the sesame oil 5 minutes; remove.
3. Stir-fry the vegetables 4 minutes.
4. Add the chicken and sauce and toss 1 minute until glossy. Serve over rice.

slots.label: Chicken Taco Salad
slots.info:
Lunch · High Protein • 20 mins
All the taco fixings in a crunchy salad.
484 kcal · 42g protein · 40g carbs · 18g fat

Ingredients:
• 8 oz chicken breast
• 1 tsp taco seasoning
• 4 cups romaine
• 1/2 cup black beans
• 1/2 cup corn
• 1/2 cup shredded cheddar
• 1/4 cup salsa
• 2 tbsp sour cream
• 1 cup tortilla chips

Steps:
1. Season the chicken with taco seasoning and cook 6 minutes per side; slice.
2. Toss the romaine with beans and corn.
3. Top with chicken, cheese, salsa, sour cream and crushed chips.

slots.label: Chicken Tikka Masala
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 40 mins
Spiced chicken in a creamy tomato sauce with basmati rice.
607 kcal · 43g protein · 50g carbs · 26g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 1/2 lb chicken thighs, cubed
• 1/2 cup plain Greek yogurt
• 2 tbsp garam masala
• 1 onion, diced
• 3 garlic cloves
• 1 tsp fresh ginger
• 1 can crushed tomatoes
• 1/2 cup heavy cream
• 1 tbsp butter
• 1 cup basmati rice

Steps:
1. Toss the chicken with yogurt and 1 tbsp garam masala; rest 10 minutes.
2. Cook the rice.
3. Brown the chicken in the butter 6 minutes; remove.
4. Cook the onion 5 minutes, add garlic, ginger and remaining garam masala, then the tomatoes. Simmer 10 minutes.
5. Stir in the cream and chicken; simmer 5 minutes. Serve with rice.

slots.label: Chicken Tortilla Soup
slots.info:
Lunch · High Protein • 35 mins
Brothy and smoky with all the toppings.
391 kcal · 37g protein · 45g carbs · 8g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 lb chicken breast
• 4 cups chicken broth
• 1 can diced tomatoes
• 1 can black beans, drained
• 1 cup corn
• 1 onion, diced
• 2 garlic cloves
• 1 tbsp chili powder
• 1 tsp cumin
• 1 lime
• 1 cup tortilla chips
• 1/2 avocado

Steps:
1. Sauté the onion 5 minutes in a large pot, then add garlic, chili powder and cumin for 1 minute.
2. Add the broth, tomatoes and whole chicken; simmer 15 minutes. Shred the chicken and return it.
3. Add the beans and corn and simmer 5 minutes. Squeeze in the lime.
4. Serve topped with crushed chips and avocado.

slots.label: Chickpea Salad Sandwiches
slots.info:
Lunch · Vegetarian • 10 mins
Like egg salad, made with smashed chickpeas.
436 kcal · 18g protein · 56g carbs · 16g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 can chickpeas, drained
• 2 tbsp mayo
• 1 tsp dijon mustard
• 1 celery stalk, diced
• 1 tbsp dill
• 4 slices whole wheat bread
• 1 cup spinach

Steps:
1. Mash the chickpeas with a fork, leaving some texture.
2. Stir in mayo, mustard, celery, dill, salt and pepper.
3. Spread on bread with spinach.

slots.label: Chilaquiles Verdes
slots.info:
Breakfast · Comfort Food • 20 mins
Tortilla chips simmered in salsa verde, topped with eggs.
541 kcal · 23g protein · 62g carbs · 22g fat

Ingredients:
• 3 cups tortilla chips
• 1 cup salsa verde
• 4 large eggs
• 1/4 cup sour cream
• 2 tbsp feta
• 2 tbsp cilantro

Steps:
1. Warm the salsa verde in a large skillet until bubbling.
2. Fold in the chips and cook 1–2 minutes until just softened.
3. Fry the eggs separately.
4. Top the chips with eggs, sour cream, feta and cilantro.

slots.label: Chili Mac Freezer Meal
slots.info:
EZ Prep · High Protein • 35 mins
Cheesy chili mac that reheats perfectly.
607 kcal · 42g protein · 58g carbs · 22g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 1/2 lb lean ground beef
• 12 oz elbow pasta
• 1 can kidney beans
• 1 can diced tomatoes
• 2 cups beef broth
• 2 tbsp chili powder
• 1 1/2 cups shredded cheddar

Steps:
1. Brown the beef with chili powder.
2. Add broth, tomatoes and dry pasta; simmer covered 12 minutes, stirring.
3. Stir in beans and cheese.
4. Portion into containers; refrigerate 4 days or freeze 3 months.

slots.label: Chocolate Peanut Butter Protein Balls
slots.info:
Snack · Meal Prep • 15 mins
Like a peanut butter cup, with whey.
197 kcal · 12g protein · 20g carbs · 9g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 cup rolled oats
• 2 scoops chocolate protein powder
• 1/2 cup peanut butter
• 1/4 cup honey
• 2 tbsp milk

Steps:
1. Mix everything until it forms a dough, adding milk as needed.
2. Roll into 16 balls (two per serving) and chill.
slots.q: Chocolate Peanut Butter Protein Balls recipe

slots.label: Chocolate Peanut Butter Protein Smoothie
slots.info:
Breakfast · High Protein • 5 mins
Tastes like a milkshake, built like a meal.
454 kcal · 38g protein · 48g carbs · 16g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 cup milk
• 1 scoop chocolate protein powder
• 1 banana, frozen
• 1 tbsp peanut butter
• 1 tbsp cocoa powder
• 1/2 cup ice

Steps:
1. Add everything to a blender.
2. Blend until thick and smooth, about 45 seconds.
3. Add a splash more milk if it's too thick.
slots.q: Chocolate Peanut Butter Protein Smoothie recipe

slots.label: Chocolate Protein Mug Cake
slots.info:
Snack · High Protein • 5 mins
A warm brownie-like cake in 60 seconds.
305 kcal · 34g protein · 21g carbs · 11g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 scoop chocolate protein powder
• 1 tbsp cocoa powder
• 1 tbsp all-purpose flour
• 1/2 tsp baking powder
• 1 large egg
• 3 tbsp milk
• 1 tbsp mini chocolate chips

Steps:
1. Whisk everything in a large mug.
2. Microwave 60–75 seconds until just set.
3. Let cool 1 minute before eating.

slots.label: Chocolate Protein Overnight Oats
slots.info:
Breakfast · High Protein • 5 mins
Brownie-batter oats with a full scoop of protein.
444 kcal · 38g protein · 51g carbs · 12g fat

Ingredients:
• 1/2 cup rolled oats
• 1 scoop chocolate protein powder
• 3/4 cup milk
• 1 tbsp chia seeds
• 1 tbsp cocoa powder
• 1 tsp maple syrup

Steps:
1. Whisk the protein powder, cocoa and milk until smooth.
2. Stir in the oats, chia and maple syrup.
3. Refrigerate overnight; stir before eating.

slots.label: Cinnamon Apple Chips
slots.info:
Snack · Balanced • 120 mins
Crispy baked apple chips.
71 kcal · 0g protein · 19g carbs · 0g fat

Ingredients:
• 3 apples, thinly sliced
• 1 tsp cinnamon

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 225°F.
2. Lay the apple slices on parchment-lined sheets and dust with cinnamon.
3. Bake 1 hour, flip, and bake 1 more hour until crisp.

slots.label: Cinnamon French Toast
slots.info:
Breakfast · Comfort Food • 20 mins
Custardy French toast with cinnamon and vanilla.
423 kcal · 20g protein · 49g carbs · 16g fat

Ingredients:
• 4 slices sourdough
• 3 large eggs
• 1/2 cup milk
• 1 tsp cinnamon
• 1 tsp vanilla extract
• 1 tbsp butter
• 1 cup strawberries, sliced
• 2 tbsp maple syrup

Steps:
1. Whisk the eggs, milk, cinnamon and vanilla in a shallow dish.
2. Melt half the butter in a skillet over medium heat.
3. Dip each bread slice for about 10 seconds per side so it soaks through.
4. Cook 2–3 minutes per side until golden, adding the rest of the butter as needed.
5. Top with strawberries and maple syrup.

slots.label: Cinnamon Roll Protein Oatmeal
slots.info:
Breakfast · Balanced • 10 mins
Creamy oats with vanilla protein and a cream-cheese swirl.
402 kcal · 26g protein · 46g carbs · 13g fat

Ingredients:
• 1/2 cup rolled oats
• 1 cup milk
• 1/2 scoop vanilla protein powder
• 1 tsp cinnamon
• 1 tbsp cream cheese
• 1 tsp maple syrup

Steps:
1. Cook the oats in the milk with cinnamon for 4–5 minutes.
2. Off the heat, stir in the protein powder until smooth.
3. Warm the cream cheese with maple syrup for 10 seconds and swirl on top.

slots.label: Classic Diner Breakfast Scramble
slots.info:
Breakfast · High Protein • 15 mins
Fluffy scrambled eggs with crispy bacon, cheddar and toast — the Saturday morning standard.
539 kcal · 37g protein · 28g carbs · 30g fat

Ingredients:
• 6 large eggs
• 2 tbsp milk
• 4 slices bacon
• 1/4 cup shredded cheddar
• 4 slices whole wheat bread
• 1 tsp butter
• Salt and pepper

Steps:
1. Cook the bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crisp, 6–8 minutes. Drain on a paper towel and wipe out most of the grease.
2. Whisk the eggs, milk, salt and pepper until no streaks remain.
3. Melt the butter in the skillet over medium-low. Add the eggs and stir slowly with a spatula, pushing curds toward the center.
4. When the eggs are almost set but still glossy, sprinkle on the cheddar and turn off the heat.
5. Toast the bread and serve with the eggs and bacon.

slots.label: Classic Spaghetti & Meat Sauce
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 35 mins
A family-favorite Bolognese-style sauce over spaghetti.
641 kcal · 39g protein · 81g carbs · 17g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 lb lean ground beef
• 12 oz spaghetti
• 1 jar marinara
• 1 onion, diced
• 3 garlic cloves
• 1 tsp italian seasoning
• 1/4 cup parmesan

Steps:
1. Brown the beef with the onion over medium-high 8 minutes; drain any fat.
2. Add the garlic and Italian seasoning for 1 minute, then the marinara. Simmer 15 minutes.
3. Cook the spaghetti; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
4. Toss the pasta with sauce, loosening with pasta water. Top with parmesan.

slots.label: Cobb Salad
slots.info:
Lunch · High Protein • 20 mins
Chicken, bacon, egg, avocado and blue cheese on crisp greens.
525 kcal · 52g protein · 12g carbs · 30g fat

Ingredients:
• 8 oz cooked chicken, diced
• 4 cups romaine, chopped
• 2 hard-boiled eggs, chopped
• 4 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
• 1/2 avocado, diced
• 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved
• 2 tbsp feta
• 3 tbsp ranch

Steps:
1. Spread the romaine on two plates.
2. Arrange the chicken, eggs, bacon, avocado, tomatoes and cheese in rows on top.
3. Drizzle with ranch just before eating.

slots.label: Coconut Shrimp Curry
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 25 mins
A quick creamy curry with shrimp and spinach.
607 kcal · 39g protein · 48g carbs · 31g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 lb shrimp
• 1 can light coconut milk
• 2 tbsp curry powder
• 1 onion, diced
• 2 garlic cloves
• 1 can diced tomatoes
• 2 cups spinach
• 1 tsp olive oil
• 2 cups cooked rice

Steps:
1. Cook the onion in the oil 5 minutes; add garlic and curry powder 1 minute.
2. Add the tomatoes and coconut milk; simmer 8 minutes.
3. Add the shrimp and cook 3 minutes; stir in spinach.
4. Serve over rice.

slots.label: Cottage Cheese & Pineapple Cup
slots.info:
Snack · No Cook • 3 mins
A retro classic that keeps you full.
247 kcal · 26g protein · 22g carbs · 6g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 cup cottage cheese
• 1/2 cup pineapple
• 1 tsp chia seeds

Steps:
1. Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl.
2. Top with pineapple and chia seeds.

slots.label: Cottage Cheese Breakfast Bowl
slots.info:
Breakfast · High Protein • 5 mins
Savory cottage cheese with tomato, cucumber and everything seasoning.
345 kcal · 31g protein · 31g carbs · 11g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 cup cottage cheese
• 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes, halved
• 1/2 cucumber, diced
• 1 tsp everything bagel seasoning
• 1 tsp olive oil
• 1 slices whole wheat bread

Steps:
1. Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl.
2. Top with tomatoes and cucumber.
3. Drizzle with oil, sprinkle seasoning, and serve with toast.

slots.label: Cottage Cheese Pancakes
slots.info:
Breakfast · Vegetarian • 15 mins
Tender, custardy pancakes with a surprise protein boost.
330 kcal · 25g protein · 32g carbs · 11g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 cup cottage cheese
• 3 large eggs
• 1/2 cup rolled oats
• 1 tbsp honey
• 1/2 tsp baking powder
• 1/2 tsp vanilla extract
• 1/2 cup blueberries

Steps:
1. Blend the cottage cheese, eggs, oats, honey, baking powder and vanilla until smooth.
2. Cook 1/4-cup portions on a greased pan over medium-low, 2–3 minutes per side.
3. Serve with blueberries.

slots.id: recipe:Creamy Garlic Parmesan Orzo with Chicken
slots.label: Creamy Garlic Parmesan Orzo with Chicken
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 30 mins
Risotto-like orzo cooked in broth with chicken and spinach.
372 kcal · 37g protein · 31g carbs · 10g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 lb chicken breast, cubed
• 1 1/2 cups orzo
• 3 cups chicken broth
• 3 garlic cloves
• 1/2 cup parmesan
• 2 cups spinach
• 1 tbsp butter

Steps:
1. Brown the chicken in the butter 6 minutes.
2. Add garlic, then orzo and broth. Simmer, stirring often, 10 minutes until creamy.
3. Stir in parmesan and spinach until wilted.
slots.q: Creamy Garlic Parmesan Orzo with Chicken recipe

slots.label: Creamy Tuscan Chicken
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 30 mins
Seared chicken in a garlic-parmesan cream sauce with spinach and sun-dried tomatoes.
434 kcal · 44g protein · 4g carbs · 26g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 1/2 lb chicken breast
• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 3 garlic cloves
• 3/4 cup heavy cream
• 1/2 cup chicken broth
• 1/3 cup parmesan
• 1/3 cup sun-dried tomatoes
• 3 cups spinach
• 1 tsp italian seasoning

Steps:
1. Season and sear the chicken in the oil 6 minutes per side; remove.
2. Cook the garlic 30 seconds, then add cream, broth, parmesan, sun-dried tomatoes and Italian seasoning. Simmer 3 minutes.
3. Stir in the spinach until wilted.
4. Return the chicken and spoon the sauce over. Great with rice or pasta.

slots.label: Croissant-Style Egg Sandwich on Brioche
slots.info:
Breakfast · Comfort Food • 15 mins
Soft scrambled eggs, cheese and avocado on toasted brioche.
500 kcal · 24g protein · 32g carbs · 30g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 brioche buns
• 4 large eggs
• 2 slices american cheese
• 1/2 avocado, sliced
• 1 tbsp butter
• 2 tbsp milk

Steps:
1. Whisk the eggs with milk. Cook low and slow in the butter, stirring, until creamy.
2. Toast the buns.
3. Pile in the eggs, cheese and avocado.
slots.q: Croissant-Style Egg Sandwich on Brioche recipe

slots.label: Denver Omelet
slots.info:
Breakfast · Balanced • 15 mins
Ham, peppers and onion folded into a cheesy omelet.
328 kcal · 27g protein · 5g carbs · 22g fat

Ingredients:
• 5 large eggs
• 1/2 cup diced ham
• 1/2 bell pepper, diced
• 1/4 onion, diced
• 1/3 cup shredded cheddar
• 1 tsp butter
• Salt and pepper

Steps:
1. Melt the butter in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Sauté the ham, pepper and onion for 4 minutes until soft; set aside.
2. Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper.
3. Pour half the eggs into the skillet. As the edges set, lift them so raw egg runs underneath.
4. When the top is just set, add half the filling and cheese to one side, fold, and slide onto a plate.
5. Repeat for the second omelet.

slots.label: Deviled Eggs
slots.info:
Snack · Balanced • 20 mins
Creamy, tangy and topped with paprika.
157 kcal · 10g protein · 1g carbs · 12g fat

Ingredients:
• 6 large eggs
• 2 tbsp mayo
• 1 tbsp plain Greek yogurt
• 1 tsp dijon mustard
• 1/4 tsp paprika

Steps:
1. Hard-boil the eggs 11 minutes, cool in ice water, and peel.
2. Halve and pop out the yolks.
3. Mash the yolks with mayo, yogurt, mustard, salt and pepper.
4. Spoon back into the whites and dust with paprika.

slots.label: Edamame with Sea Salt
slots.info:
Snack · Vegetarian • 5 mins
Warm, salty and full of protein.
188 kcal · 19g protein · 14g carbs · 8g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 cups edamame
• 1/2 tsp salt
• 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes

Steps:
1. Microwave or steam the edamame 4 minutes.
2. Toss with salt and red pepper flakes.

slots.label: Egg & Veggie Breakfast Tacos
slots.info:
Breakfast · Vegetarian • 15 mins
Soft corn tortillas filled with peppers, eggs and pico.
425 kcal · 22g protein · 43g carbs · 19g fat

Ingredients:
• 5 large eggs
• 6 corn tortillas
• 1/2 bell pepper, diced
• 1/4 onion, diced
• 1/4 cup pico de gallo
• 1/4 avocado
• 1 tsp olive oil

Steps:
1. Sauté the pepper and onion in the oil 4 minutes.
2. Add the beaten eggs and scramble until just set.
3. Warm the tortillas and fill with eggs, pico and avocado.

slots.label: Egg Roll in a Bowl
slots.info:
EZ Prep · Balanced • 20 mins
All the egg roll flavor, no wrapper, one pan.
238 kcal · 25g protein · 13g carbs · 10g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 lb ground turkey
• 1 bag coleslaw mix
• 3 garlic cloves
• 1 tsp fresh ginger
• 3 tbsp soy sauce
• 1 tsp sesame oil
• 2 green onions
• 1 tsp sriracha

Steps:
1. Brown the turkey 6 minutes.
2. Add garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
3. Add the slaw and soy sauce; cook 5 minutes until just tender.
4. Finish with sesame oil, sriracha and green onions.
slots.q: Egg Roll in a Bowl recipe

slots.label: Egg Salad Sandwiches
slots.info:
Lunch · High Protein • 20 mins
Creamy, classic, with a little mustard.
578 kcal · 36g protein · 48g carbs · 29g fat

Ingredients:
• 6 large eggs
• 2 tbsp mayo
• 2 tbsp plain Greek yogurt
• 1 tsp dijon mustard
• 1/2 tsp paprika
• 4 slices whole wheat bread
• 2 lettuce leaves

Steps:
1. Hard-boil the eggs 11 minutes, cool in ice water and peel.
2. Chop and mix with mayo, yogurt, mustard, paprika, salt and pepper.
3. Spread onto bread with lettuce.

slots.label: Fish Tacos with Chipotle Crema
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 25 mins
Crispy-seasoned white fish, slaw and smoky sauce.
354 kcal · 33g protein · 30g carbs · 12g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 lb cod
• 1 tsp chili powder
• 1 tsp cumin
• 6 corn tortillas
• 2 cups cabbage
• 1/3 cup sour cream
• 1 tsp chipotle powder
• 1 lime
• 1 tbsp olive oil

Steps:
1. Season the fish with chili powder, cumin and salt; sear in the oil 3 minutes per side. Flake.
2. Stir the sour cream, chipotle and lime juice.
3. Fill warm tortillas with cabbage, fish and crema.
slots.q: Fish Tacos with Chipotle Crema recipe

slots.label: Fluffy Buttermilk-Style Pancakes
slots.info:
Breakfast · Comfort Food • 20 mins
Tall, tender pancakes using regular milk and a splash of lemon.
473 kcal · 12g protein · 79g carbs · 12g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
• 2 tbsp sugar
• 2 tsp baking powder
• 1/2 tsp baking soda
• 1 1/4 cups milk
• 1 tbsp lemon juice
• 1 large egg
• 2 tbsp butter, melted
• 1/4 cup maple syrup

Steps:
1. Stir the lemon juice into the milk and let it sit 5 minutes.
2. Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and a pinch of salt in a bowl.
3. Whisk the egg and melted butter into the milk, then pour into the dry ingredients. Stir until just combined — lumps are fine.
4. Heat a greased griddle over medium. Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake; flip when bubbles pop on top, about 2 minutes per side.
5. Serve with maple syrup.

slots.label: French Dip Sandwiches
slots.info:
Lunch · High Protein • 20 mins
Thin roast-beef-style steak with a warm dipping broth.
465 kcal · 35g protein · 31g carbs · 21g fat

Ingredients:
• 8 oz sirloin steak, thinly sliced
• 2 hoagie rolls
• 2 slices provolone
• 1 1/2 cups beef broth
• 1/2 onion, sliced
• 1 tsp worcestershire
• 1 tsp butter

Steps:
1. Cook the onion in the butter 6 minutes until soft.
2. Add broth and Worcestershire; simmer 5 minutes.
3. Dip the steak slices in the simmering broth for 1 minute to cook.
4. Pile into rolls with provolone and serve with broth for dipping.

slots.label: Frozen Yogurt Blueberry Bites
slots.info:
Snack · Balanced • 10 mins
Little frozen bursts of berry and yogurt.
80 kcal · 7g protein · 13g carbs · 0g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 1/2 cups blueberries
• 1 cup plain Greek yogurt
• 1 tbsp honey

Steps:
1. Stir the honey into the yogurt.
2. Roll blueberries in yogurt and place on a parchment-lined tray.
3. Freeze 1 hour.

slots.label: Garlic Butter Steak Bites & Potatoes
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 30 mins
Seared sirloin cubes and crispy baby potatoes tossed in garlic butter.
626 kcal · 41g protein · 41g carbs · 33g fat

Ingredients:
• 12 oz sirloin steak, cubed
• 1 lb baby potatoes, halved
• 2 tbsp butter
• 4 garlic cloves, minced
• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 1 tbsp parsley

Steps:
1. Microwave the potatoes covered 5 minutes, then crisp them in the oil in a skillet 8 minutes. Remove.
2. Turn the heat to high, add the steak in one layer, and sear 2–3 minutes, turning once.
3. Lower the heat, add the butter and garlic, and toss 1 minute.
4. Return the potatoes, toss, and finish with parsley.
slots.q: Garlic Butter Steak Bites & Potatoes recipe

slots.label: Garlic Shrimp & Broccoli
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 20 mins
A light, fast stir-fry with tons of garlic.
432 kcal · 43g protein · 48g carbs · 9g fat

Ingredients:
• 12 oz shrimp
• 3 cups broccoli florets
• 4 garlic cloves
• 2 tbsp soy sauce
• 1 tsp honey
• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 1 1/2 cups cooked rice

Steps:
1. Steam-fry the broccoli in half the oil with 2 tbsp water, 3 minutes.
2. Add the remaining oil, garlic and shrimp; cook 3–4 minutes.
3. Stir in soy sauce and honey. Serve over rice.

slots.label: Greek Chicken Meal Prep
slots.info:
EZ Prep · High Protein • 35 mins
Lemon-oregano chicken with orzo, cucumbers and tzatziki.
439 kcal · 43g protein · 26g carbs · 17g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 1/2 lb chicken breast
• 1 cup orzo
• 1 cucumber
• 1 cup cherry tomatoes
• 1/2 cup tzatziki
• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 1 lemon
• 1 tsp oregano

Steps:
1. Marinate the chicken in oil, lemon and oregano 10 minutes; bake at 425°F for 20 minutes.
2. Cook the orzo.
3. Divide orzo, chicken, cucumber and tomatoes among 4 containers with tzatziki on the side.

slots.label: Greek Chicken Pita Pockets
slots.info:
Lunch · High Protein • 20 mins
Lemony chicken with cucumber, tomato and tzatziki.
551 kcal · 39g protein · 45g carbs · 23g fat

Ingredients:
• 10 oz chicken breast, cubed
• 2 pitas
• 1/2 cucumber, diced
• 1 tomato, diced
• 1/4 red onion, sliced
• 1/3 cup tzatziki
• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 1 tsp oregano
• 1 lemon

Steps:
1. Toss the chicken with oil, oregano, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
2. Cook in a hot skillet 7–8 minutes until browned and cooked through.
3. Warm the pitas and cut open.
4. Fill with chicken, cucumber, tomato, onion and tzatziki.

slots.label: Greek Lemon Chicken Sheet Pan
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 40 mins
Chicken, potatoes and red onion with oregano and feta.
484 kcal · 39g protein · 33g carbs · 21g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 1/2 lb chicken thighs
• 1 1/2 lb potatoes, cubed
• 1 red onion, wedges
• 2 tbsp olive oil
• 1 lemon
• 2 tsp oregano
• 1/3 cup feta

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 425°F.
2. Toss everything except the feta with salt and pepper on a sheet pan.
3. Roast 35 minutes, stirring once.
4. Sprinkle with feta.
slots.q: Greek Lemon Chicken Sheet Pan recipe

slots.label: Greek Yogurt Berry Parfait
slots.info:
Breakfast · Post-Workout • 3 mins
High casein protein with berries.
260 kcal · 23g protein · 29g carbs · 6g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 cup greek yogurt
• 1/2 cup mixed berries
• 1 tbsp honey

Steps:
1. Spoon half the yogurt into a glass or bowl.
2. Add half the berries, then the rest of the yogurt and berries.
3. Drizzle with honey. Add a spoonful of granola for crunch if you like.

slots.label: Greek Yogurt Power Bowl
slots.info:
Breakfast · High Protein • 5 mins
Thick yogurt with granola, berries and a drizzle of honey.
463 kcal · 32g protein · 58g carbs · 13g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 cup plain Greek yogurt
• 1/3 cup granola
• 3/4 cup mixed berries
• 1 tbsp chia seeds
• 1 tsp honey

Steps:
1. Spoon the yogurt into a bowl.
2. Top with berries, granola and chia seeds.
3. Drizzle with honey and eat right away so the granola stays crunchy.

slots.label: Greek Yogurt Ranch Veggie Dip
slots.info:
Snack · Vegetarian • 10 mins
Creamy, protein-packed dip with crunchy vegetables.
94 kcal · 11g protein · 12g carbs · 1g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 1/2 cups plain Greek yogurt
• 1 tbsp ranch seasoning
• 1 tbsp dill
• 2 carrots, cut in sticks
• 1 cucumber, sliced
• 1 bell pepper, sliced
• 1 cup cherry tomatoes

Steps:
1. Stir the ranch seasoning and dill into the yogurt.
2. Chill 10 minutes for the flavors to bloom.
3. Serve with the vegetables for dipping.
slots.q: Greek Yogurt Ranch Veggie Dip recipe

slots.label: Grilled Chicken & Rice Bowl
slots.info:
Lunch · High Protein • 15 mins
Classic bodybuilding meal.
480 kcal · 45g protein · 52g carbs · 10g fat

Ingredients:
• 6 oz chicken breast
• 1 cup cooked jasmine rice
• 1 cup broccoli florets
• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 1/2 tsp garlic powder
• 1 tsp soy sauce

Steps:
1. Season the chicken with garlic powder, salt and pepper.
2. Heat half the oil in a skillet over medium-high and cook the chicken 5–6 minutes per side until it reaches 165°F. Rest 5 minutes, then slice.
3. Steam or microwave the broccoli 3–4 minutes until bright green.
4. Warm the rice, top with chicken and broccoli, and drizzle with the remaining oil and soy sauce.

slots.label: Grilled Chicken BLT Wrap
slots.info:
Lunch · High Protein • 15 mins
A BLT with chicken for staying power.
517 kcal · 46g protein · 26g carbs · 24g fat

Ingredients:
• 8 oz cooked chicken, sliced
• 4 slices bacon, cooked
• 2 flour tortillas
• 1 cup romaine
• 1 tomato, sliced
• 2 tbsp mayo

Steps:
1. Spread mayo on the tortillas.
2. Layer lettuce, tomato, chicken and bacon.
3. Roll tightly and cut in half.

slots.label: Grilled Chicken Caesar Pasta
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 25 mins
Warm pasta, crisp romaine and chicken in Caesar dressing.
565 kcal · 41g protein · 67g carbs · 14g fat

Ingredients:
• 12 oz penne
• 1 lb chicken breast
• 1/3 cup caesar dressing
• 4 cups romaine, chopped
• 1/3 cup parmesan
• 1 tsp olive oil

Steps:
1. Cook the pasta and drain.
2. Season and cook the chicken in the oil 6 minutes per side; slice.
3. Toss the warm pasta with dressing, then fold in romaine, chicken and parmesan.

slots.label: Ground Turkey Sweet Potato Skillet
slots.info:
Dinner · Meal Prep • 30 mins
Turkey, sweet potato, peppers and spinach — a meal-prep favorite.
326 kcal · 27g protein · 16g carbs · 17g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 lb ground turkey
• 2 sweet potatoes, diced small
• 1 bell pepper, diced
• 2 cups spinach
• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 1 tsp chili powder
• 1/2 tsp garlic powder
• 1/2 cup shredded cheddar

Steps:
1. Cook the sweet potatoes in the oil covered 10 minutes.
2. Add the turkey and spices; brown 7 minutes.
3. Add the pepper and spinach and cook 3 minutes.
4. Top with cheddar and cover to melt.
slots.q: Ground Turkey Sweet Potato Skillet recipe

slots.label: Guacamole & Veggie Chips
slots.info:
Snack · Vegetarian • 10 mins
Chunky homemade guac.
268 kcal · 5g protein · 30g carbs · 16g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 avocados
• 1/4 red onion, minced
• 1 tomato, diced
• 1 lime
• 2 tbsp cilantro
• 1 jalapeño, minced
• 1 1/2 cups tortilla chips

Steps:
1. Mash the avocados with lime juice and salt.
2. Fold in the onion, tomato, cilantro and jalapeño.
3. Serve with chips.

slots.label: Ham & Swiss Egg Bake
slots.info:
Breakfast · Meal Prep • 50 mins
A make-ahead casserole for busy weeks or brunch guests.
335 kcal · 28g protein · 13g carbs · 19g fat

Ingredients:
• 12 large eggs
• 1 cup milk
• 1 1/2 cups diced ham
• 1 cup swiss cheese, shredded
• 4 slices whole wheat bread, cubed
• 1 cup spinach
• 1 tsp dijon mustard

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 350°F and grease a 9x13 dish.
2. Spread the bread cubes, ham, spinach and cheese in the dish.
3. Whisk the eggs, milk, mustard, salt and pepper; pour over.
4. Bake 40–45 minutes until puffed and set in the center. Rest 5 minutes before cutting.

slots.label: Hard-Boiled Egg Snack Box
slots.info:
Snack · Meal Prep • 15 mins
A protein bistro box like the coffee-shop version.
454 kcal · 24g protein · 29g carbs · 28g fat

Ingredients:
• 4 large eggs
• 2 oz cheddar, cubed
• 1 apple, sliced
• 1/4 cup almonds
• 1 cup grapes

Steps:
1. Hard-boil the eggs 11 minutes; cool and peel.
2. Divide eggs, cheese, apple, almonds and grapes between two containers.

slots.label: Hawaiian Chicken Skewers
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 35 mins
Chicken, pineapple and peppers glazed with teriyaki.
448 kcal · 43g protein · 54g carbs · 5g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 1/2 lb chicken breast, cubed
• 2 cups pineapple chunks
• 2 bell peppers, chunks
• 1/2 cup teriyaki sauce
• 3 cups cooked rice

Steps:
1. Thread the chicken, pineapple and peppers onto skewers.
2. Grill or broil 10–12 minutes, turning and brushing with teriyaki.
3. Serve over rice.

slots.label: Hawaiian Ham & Cheese Sliders
slots.info:
Lunch · Comfort Food • 25 mins
Sweet rolls with ham, swiss and a buttery mustard glaze.
515 kcal · 25g protein · 57g carbs · 20g fat

Ingredients:
• 8 slider buns
• 8 oz ham
• 4 slices swiss cheese
• 2 tbsp butter, melted
• 1 tsp dijon mustard
• 1 tsp poppy seeds

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 350°F.
2. Split the buns as one slab and layer ham and swiss; replace the tops.
3. Brush with butter mixed with mustard and poppy seeds.
4. Cover with foil and bake 15 minutes, then uncover 5 minutes.

slots.label: Herb-Crusted Pork Tenderloin
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 35 mins
Juicy roasted pork with roasted Brussels sprouts.
316 kcal · 40g protein · 11g carbs · 13g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 1/2 lb pork tenderloin
• 1 tbsp dijon mustard
• 2 garlic cloves
• 1 tsp rosemary
• 1 tsp thyme
• 1 lb brussels sprouts, halved
• 2 tbsp olive oil

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 425°F.
2. Rub the pork with mustard, garlic, herbs, salt and pepper.
3. Sear in 1 tbsp oil 2 minutes per side, then move to a sheet pan with the sprouts tossed in the remaining oil.
4. Roast 18–20 minutes until the pork reaches 145°F. Rest 5 minutes and slice.

slots.label: Homemade Cheeseburgers
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 25 mins
Juicy smashed burgers with all the fixings.
662 kcal · 52g protein · 53g carbs · 28g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 1/2 lb lean ground beef
• 4 hamburger buns
• 4 slices american cheese
• 4 lettuce leaves
• 1 tomato, sliced
• 1/4 red onion
• 2 tbsp ketchup
• 1 tbsp mustard

Steps:
1. Divide the beef into 4 balls. Heat a cast-iron skillet very hot.
2. Smash each ball flat, season, and cook 2–3 minutes; flip, add cheese, cook 2 minutes.
3. Toast the buns and build burgers with toppings and sauces.

slots.label: Honey Garlic Chicken Thigh Prep
slots.info:
EZ Prep · High Protein • 35 mins
Sticky baked thighs with roasted sweet potato and green beans.
493 kcal · 48g protein · 33g carbs · 19g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 lb chicken thighs
• 3 tbsp honey
• 3 tbsp soy sauce
• 3 garlic cloves
• 2 sweet potatoes, cubed
• 3 cups green beans
• 1 tbsp olive oil

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 425°F.
2. Toss the chicken in honey, soy sauce and garlic.
3. Roast the chicken with the oiled sweet potatoes 25 minutes; add green beans for the last 12.
4. Portion into 4 containers.
slots.q: Honey Garlic Chicken Thigh Prep recipe

slots.label: Honey Garlic Salmon
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 20 mins
Sticky-sweet glazed salmon with rice and green beans.
816 kcal · 44g protein · 100g carbs · 25g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 salmon fillets
• 2 tbsp honey
• 2 tbsp soy sauce
• 2 garlic cloves
• 1 tsp butter
• 1 cup jasmine rice
• 2 cups green beans

Steps:
1. Cook the rice.
2. Whisk the honey, soy sauce and garlic.
3. Sear the salmon in butter 4 minutes skin-side up, flip, pour in the sauce and cook 3 minutes, spooning it over.
4. Steam the green beans and serve everything together.

slots.label: Honey Mustard Chicken Salad
slots.info:
Lunch · High Protein • 20 mins
Crispy chicken bites over greens with a sweet-tangy dressing.
330 kcal · 36g protein · 21g carbs · 11g fat

Ingredients:
• 10 oz chicken breast, cubed
• 1/4 cup panko
• 5 cups mixed greens
• 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes
• 1/2 cucumber
• 1 tbsp honey
• 1 tbsp dijon mustard
• 1 tbsp olive oil

Steps:
1. Toss the chicken with salt and panko. Pan-fry in the oil 6–7 minutes until golden.
2. Whisk honey, mustard and 1 tbsp water.
3. Toss the greens and vegetables with half the dressing; top with chicken and drizzle the rest.

slots.label: Honey Sriracha Chicken Thighs
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 35 mins
Sweet heat glaze with roasted carrots.
458 kcal · 46g protein · 25g carbs · 19g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 lb chicken thighs
• 3 tbsp honey
• 2 tbsp sriracha
• 2 tbsp soy sauce
• 1 lb carrots
• 1 tbsp olive oil

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 425°F.
2. Whisk honey, sriracha and soy sauce.
3. Arrange chicken and oiled carrots on a sheet pan; brush chicken with half the glaze.
4. Roast 25 minutes, brushing with remaining glaze halfway.

slots.label: Huevos Rancheros
slots.info:
Breakfast · High Protein • 20 mins
Fried eggs on crisp corn tortillas with beans and salsa.
523 kcal · 30g protein · 61g carbs · 19g fat

Ingredients:
• 4 large eggs
• 4 corn tortillas
• 1 can black beans, drained
• 1/2 cup salsa
• 1/4 avocado, sliced
• 2 tbsp feta
• 1 tsp olive oil
• 1/2 tsp cumin

Steps:
1. Warm the beans with the cumin and a splash of water, mashing a little.
2. Crisp the tortillas in a dry skillet, about 1 minute per side.
3. Add the oil to the skillet and fry the eggs to your liking.
4. Layer tortillas, beans, eggs and salsa; top with avocado and feta.

slots.label: Hummus & Pita Chips Plate
slots.info:
Snack · Vegetarian • 5 mins
A snack board for two.
241 kcal · 8g protein · 33g carbs · 10g fat

Ingredients:
• 1/2 cup hummus
• 1 cup pita chips
• 1 cucumber, sliced
• 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes
• 1/4 cup kalamata olives

Steps:
1. Spoon the hummus onto a plate.
2. Arrange chips, cucumber, tomatoes and olives around it.

slots.label: Instant Pot Shredded Chicken
slots.info:
EZ Prep · High Protein • 30 mins
Plain shredded chicken for tacos, salads, wraps and bowls all week.
275 kcal · 51g protein · 0g carbs · 6g fat

Ingredients:
• 3 lb chicken breast
• 1 cup chicken broth
• 1 tsp garlic powder
• 1 tsp salt

Steps:
1. Put the chicken, broth and seasonings in the Instant Pot.
2. Pressure cook 12 minutes; natural release 5 minutes.
3. Shred with two forks and toss with some of the juices.
4. Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze in portions.

slots.label: Italian Sub Sandwich
slots.info:
Lunch · Comfort Food • 10 mins
Deli meats, provolone and a zippy oil-and-vinegar dressing.
411 kcal · 26g protein · 34g carbs · 19g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 hoagie rolls
• 3 oz deli turkey
• 3 oz ham
• 2 slices provolone
• 1 cup shredded lettuce
• 1 tomato, sliced
• 1/4 red onion, sliced
• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 1 tbsp red wine vinegar
• 1/2 tsp oregano

Steps:
1. Whisk the oil, vinegar and oregano.
2. Split the rolls and layer provolone, turkey and ham.
3. Add lettuce, tomato and onion and drizzle with the dressing.

slots.label: Jerk Chicken with Rice & Beans
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 40 mins
Caribbean-spiced chicken with coconut rice and beans.
702 kcal · 55g protein · 55g carbs · 29g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 lb chicken thighs
• 2 tbsp jerk seasoning
• 1 cup rice
• 1 can kidney beans
• 1 cup light coconut milk
• 1 cup water
• 1 lime

Steps:
1. Rub the chicken with jerk seasoning; roast at 425°F for 30 minutes.
2. Simmer the rice in coconut milk and water 18 minutes; fold in the beans.
3. Serve the chicken over rice with lime.
slots.q: Jerk Chicken with Rice & Beans recipe

slots.label: Jerky & Nuts Trail Pack
slots.info:
Snack · Balanced • 2 mins
Grab-and-go protein for busy days.
371 kcal · 20g protein · 9g carbs · 29g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 oz beef jerky
• 1 oz almonds
• 1 cheddar cheese stick

Steps:
1. Pack together in a container or bag.

slots.label: Korean Beef Bowls
slots.info:
Dinner · Balanced • 20 mins
Sweet-savory ground beef with rice and quick cucumbers.
457 kcal · 29g protein · 49g carbs · 16g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 lb lean ground beef
• 1/4 cup soy sauce
• 2 tbsp brown sugar
• 1 tbsp sesame oil
• 3 garlic cloves
• 1 tsp fresh ginger
• 3 cups cooked rice
• 1 cucumber, sliced
• 2 green onions
• 1 tsp sesame seeds

Steps:
1. Brown the beef 7 minutes; drain.
2. Add garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then soy sauce, brown sugar and sesame oil. Simmer 2 minutes.
3. Serve over rice with cucumber, green onions and sesame seeds.

slots.label: Lasagna

Dinner · High Protein • 75 mins
Layers of meat sauce, ricotta and mozzarella.
435 kcal · 32g protein · 33g carbs · 19g fat

Ingredients:
• 12 lasagna noodles
• 1 lb lean ground beef
• 1 jar marinara
• 15 oz ricotta
• 1 large egg
• 2 cups mozzarella
• 1/2 cup parmesan
• 1 tsp italian seasoning

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 375°F. Cook the noodles.
2. Brown the beef and stir in the marinara.
3. Mix the ricotta, egg, half the parmesan and Italian seasoning.
4. Layer sauce, noodles, ricotta and mozzarella three times, ending with sauce and cheese.
5. Cover with foil and bake 25 minutes; uncover and bake 20 more. Rest 15 minutes.

slots.label: Lemon Garlic Butter Cod
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 20 mins
Flaky cod baked with lemon and garlic butter, with roasted asparagus.
296 kcal · 37g protein · 12g carbs · 13g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 cod fillets
• 1 1/2 tbsp butter, melted
• 2 garlic cloves
• 1 lemon
• 1 bunch asparagus
• 1 tsp olive oil

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 400°F.
2. Toss the asparagus with oil and salt on one side of a sheet pan.
3. Put the cod on the other side; spoon over butter mixed with garlic and lemon juice.
4. Bake 12–14 minutes until the fish flakes.

slots.label: Lemon Herb Orzo Salad
slots.info:
Lunch · Vegetarian • 20 mins
Bright orzo salad with cucumber, feta and herbs.
227 kcal · 7g protein · 26g carbs · 11g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 cup orzo
• 1 cucumber, diced
• 1 cup cherry tomatoes
• 1/2 cup feta
• 1/4 red onion
• 2 tbsp olive oil
• 1 lemon
• 2 tbsp parsley

Steps:
1. Cook the orzo, rinse under cold water and drain.
2. Whisk the oil, lemon juice and zest, salt and pepper.
3. Toss with the orzo, vegetables, feta and parsley.
