slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 25 mins
Baked salmon over herbed quinoa with cucumber-tomato salad.
692 kcal · 45g protein · 52g carbs · 33g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 salmon fillets
• 3/4 cup quinoa
• 1 lemon
• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 1 tbsp dill
• 1 cucumber, diced
• 1 cup cherry tomatoes

Steps:
1. Cook the quinoa.
2. Season the salmon with lemon zest, dill, salt and pepper; bake at 400°F 12 minutes.
3. Toss the cucumber and tomatoes with oil and lemon juice.
4. Serve salmon over quinoa with the salad.

slots.label: Lemon Pepper Chicken & Rice
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 35 mins
Zesty pan-seared chicken with fluffy rice and peas.
532 kcal · 46g protein · 63g carbs · 9g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 1/2 lb chicken breast
• 1 tbsp lemon pepper
• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 1 1/2 cups jasmine rice
• 3 cups chicken broth
• 1 cup frozen peas
• 1 lemon

Steps:
1. Cook the rice in the broth.
2. Season the chicken with lemon pepper; sear 6 minutes per side.
3. Stir the peas and lemon zest into the rice for the last 3 minutes.
4. Slice the chicken over the rice with a squeeze of lemon.

slots.label: Lemon Ricotta Pancakes
slots.info:
Breakfast · Vegetarian • 20 mins
Light and lemony with a hint of sweetness.
409 kcal · 20g protein · 55g carbs · 12g fat

Ingredients:
• 3/4 cup all-purpose flour
• 1/2 cup ricotta
• 1/2 cup milk
• 2 large eggs
• 1 tbsp sugar
• 1 tsp baking powder
• 1 lemon, zested and juiced
• 1/2 cup blueberries

Steps:
1. Whisk the ricotta, milk, eggs, lemon zest and juice.
2. Stir in flour, sugar and baking powder until just combined.
3. Cook 1/4-cup scoops on a greased griddle, 2 minutes per side. Top with blueberries.

slots.label: Lentil & Veggie Soup Batch
slots.info:
EZ Prep · Vegetarian • 45 mins
Big pot of hearty soup for the week.
239 kcal · 16g protein · 43g carbs · 2g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 1/2 cups lentils
• 1 onion
• 3 carrots
• 3 celery stalks
• 3 garlic cloves
• 1 can diced tomatoes
• 8 cups vegetable broth
• 1 tsp cumin
• 3 cups spinach

Steps:
1. Cook the onion, carrots and celery 6 minutes.
2. Add garlic and cumin, then lentils, tomatoes and broth.
3. Simmer 30 minutes until lentils are tender.
4. Stir in spinach. Portion and refrigerate up to 5 days.

slots.label: Loaded Baked Potato Soup
slots.info:
Lunch · Comfort Food • 35 mins
Creamy potato soup with cheddar and bacon.
466 kcal · 20g protein · 52g carbs · 20g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 lb potatoes, diced
• 4 cups chicken broth
• 1 onion, diced
• 1 cup milk
• 1/2 cup sour cream
• 1 cup shredded cheddar
• 4 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
• 2 green onions

Steps:
1. Simmer the potatoes and onion in the broth 15 minutes until tender.
2. Mash about half the potatoes in the pot.
3. Stir in milk, sour cream and cheddar until melted.
4. Top with bacon and green onions.

slots.label: Loaded Breakfast Potatoes
slots.info:
Breakfast · Comfort Food • 35 mins
Crispy roasted potatoes with cheese, bacon and green onion.
376 kcal · 14g protein · 46g carbs · 15g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 1/2 lb potatoes, diced
• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 4 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
• 1/2 cup shredded cheddar
• 2 green onions, sliced
• 1 tsp garlic powder

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes with oil, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
2. Roast 25–30 minutes, flipping once, until crisp.
3. Top with cheddar and bacon and return 2 minutes to melt.
4. Finish with green onions.

slots.label: Loaded Nachos for Two
slots.info:
Snack · Comfort Food • 15 mins
Movie-night nachos with beans, cheese and pico.
627 kcal · 25g protein · 67g carbs · 29g fat

Ingredients:
• 3 cups tortilla chips
• 1/2 cup black beans
• 1 cup shredded cheddar
• 1/4 cup pico de gallo
• 1/4 avocado
• 2 tbsp sour cream
• 1 jalapeño, sliced

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 400°F.
2. Spread chips on a sheet pan; top with beans, cheese and jalapeño.
3. Bake 6–8 minutes until melted.
4. Top with pico, avocado and sour cream.

slots.label: Loaded Sweet Potato Bowls
slots.info:
Dinner · Vegetarian • 45 mins
Roasted sweet potatoes stuffed with black beans, corn and avocado.
468 kcal · 20g protein · 69g carbs · 14g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 sweet potatoes
• 1 can black beans, drained
• 1/2 cup corn
• 1/2 avocado
• 1/4 cup salsa
• 2 tbsp sour cream
• 1/4 cup shredded cheddar

Steps:
1. Prick the sweet potatoes and bake at 425°F for 40 minutes (or microwave 8–10 minutes).
2. Warm the beans and corn.
3. Split the potatoes and fill with beans, corn, cheese, avocado, salsa and sour cream.

slots.label: Mango Chili Lime Cups
slots.info:
Snack · Balanced • 5 mins
Sweet mango with a spicy-tangy kick.
108 kcal · 2g protein · 27g carbs · 1g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 cups mango
• 1 lime
• 1/2 tsp chili powder

Steps:
1. Put the mango in cups.
2. Squeeze lime over and sprinkle with chili powder and a pinch of salt.

slots.label: Margherita Flatbread Pizzas
slots.info:
Dinner · Vegetarian • 20 mins
Crisp flatbreads with tomato, mozzarella and basil.
371 kcal · 20g protein · 43g carbs · 13g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 flatbreads
• 1/2 cup pizza sauce
• 4 oz mozzarella
• 1 tomato, sliced
• 6 basil leaves
• 1 tsp olive oil

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 450°F.
2. Spread sauce on the flatbreads and top with mozzarella and tomato.
3. Bake 8–10 minutes. Drizzle with oil and add basil.

slots.label: Mason Jar Burrito Bowls
slots.info:
EZ Prep · High Protein • 30 mins
Layered jars that stay fresh all week.
495 kcal · 43g protein · 50g carbs · 13g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 lb chicken breast
• 1 tbsp taco seasoning
• 2 cups cooked rice
• 1 can black beans
• 1 cup corn
• 1 cup salsa
• 1 cup shredded cheddar
• 2 cups romaine

Steps:
1. Cook the chicken with taco seasoning; dice.
2. Layer each jar: salsa, rice, beans, corn, chicken, cheese, then romaine on top.
3. Refrigerate up to 4 days. Shake into a bowl to eat.

slots.label: Mason Jar Greek Chicken Salad
slots.info:
EZ Prep · Meal Prep • EZ Prep
Layered salad that won't get soggy.
350 kcal · 35g protein · 12g carbs · 18g fat

Ingredients:
• 4 oz grilled chicken strips
• 1 tbsp vinaigrette
• Cherry tomatoes
• Feta
• Greens

Steps:
1. Pour the vinaigrette into the bottom of a large jar.
2. Layer the tomatoes, then feta, then chicken, and pack the greens on top so they stay crisp.
3. Seal and refrigerate up to 4 days.
4. Shake into a bowl right before eating.
slots.q: Mason Jar Greek Chicken Salad recipe

slots.label: Mediterranean Egg Scramble
slots.info:
Breakfast · Vegetarian • 15 mins
Eggs scrambled with tomato, spinach, olives and feta.
335 kcal · 23g protein · 17g carbs · 19g fat

Ingredients:
• 5 large eggs
• 1 cup spinach
• 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes, halved
• 2 tbsp kalamata olives, chopped
• 3 tbsp feta
• 1 tsp olive oil
• 2 slices whole wheat bread

Steps:
1. Sauté the tomatoes and spinach in the oil for 2 minutes.
2. Add the beaten eggs and stir gently until just set.
3. Fold in olives and feta; serve with toast.

slots.label: Mediterranean Quinoa Bowls
slots.info:
Lunch · Vegetarian • 25 mins
Quinoa, chickpeas, cucumber, olives and lemony hummus.
488 kcal · 19g protein · 67g carbs · 17g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 cup quinoa
• 1 can chickpeas, drained
• 1 cucumber, diced
• 1 cup cherry tomatoes
• 1/4 cup kalamata olives
• 1/4 cup feta
• 1/3 cup hummus
• 1 lemon
• 1 tbsp olive oil

Steps:
1. Cook the quinoa in 2 cups water, 15 minutes. Fluff and cool slightly.
2. Toss the chickpeas with oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
3. Divide quinoa into bowls and top with chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, olives and feta.
4. Add a scoop of hummus to each.

slots.label: Minestrone Soup
slots.info:
Lunch · Vegetarian • 40 mins
Hearty Italian vegetable soup with beans and pasta.
269 kcal · 14g protein · 42g carbs · 6g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 onion, diced
• 2 carrots, diced
• 2 celery stalks, diced
• 1 zucchini, diced
• 3 garlic cloves
• 1 can diced tomatoes
• 6 cups vegetable broth
• 1 can cannellini beans, drained
• 1 cup elbow pasta
• 2 cups spinach
• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 1 tsp italian seasoning
• 1/4 cup parmesan

Steps:
1. Cook the onion, carrots and celery in the oil 6 minutes.
2. Add garlic and Italian seasoning, then the tomatoes and broth. Simmer 15 minutes.
3. Add zucchini, beans and pasta; simmer 9 minutes.
4. Stir in spinach and serve with parmesan.

slots.label: Mini Pizza Bagels
slots.info:
Snack · Comfort Food • 15 mins
After-school pizza bites.
374 kcal · 20g protein · 51g carbs · 9g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 bagels, halved
• 1/4 cup pizza sauce
• 1/2 cup mozzarella
• 1 oz turkey pepperoni

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 400°F.
2. Top each bagel half with sauce, cheese and pepperoni.
3. Bake 8–10 minutes until bubbly.

slots.label: Mocha Protein Shake
slots.info:
Breakfast · No Cook • 5 mins
Coffee and protein in one cold glass.
234 kcal · 29g protein · 22g carbs · 4g fat

Ingredients:
• 3/4 cup cold brew
• 1/2 cup milk
• 1 scoop chocolate protein powder
• 1/2 banana, frozen
• 1/2 cup ice

Steps:
1. Blend everything until frothy.
2. Pour over extra ice if you like.

slots.label: Mongolian Beef
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 25 mins
Crispy beef in a sweet soy-garlic sauce.
630 kcal · 43g protein · 64g carbs · 22g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 1/2 lb flank steak, thinly sliced
• 1/4 cup cornstarch
• 2 tbsp olive oil
• 1/3 cup soy sauce
• 1/4 cup brown sugar
• 3 garlic cloves
• 1 tsp fresh ginger
• 4 green onions
• 3 cups cooked rice

Steps:
1. Toss the beef in cornstarch.
2. Fry in the oil in batches until crisp, 3 minutes; remove.
3. Simmer soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, ginger and 1/3 cup water 3 minutes.
4. Toss the beef and green onions in the sauce. Serve over rice.

slots.label: One-Pan Lemon Herb Chicken & Veggies
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 40 mins
Juicy chicken thighs roasted with potatoes, carrots and green beans.
559 kcal · 50g protein · 39g carbs · 23g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 lb chicken thighs
• 1 1/2 lb baby potatoes, halved
• 3 carrots, sliced
• 2 cups green beans
• 2 tbsp olive oil
• 1 lemon
• 3 garlic cloves
• 1 tsp italian seasoning

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 425°F.
2. Toss the potatoes and carrots with half the oil and spread on a sheet pan. Roast 10 minutes.
3. Rub the chicken with the remaining oil, lemon juice, garlic, Italian seasoning, salt and pepper.
4. Add the chicken and green beans to the pan and roast 25 minutes more until the chicken reaches 175°F.
slots.q: One-Pan Lemon Herb Chicken & Veggies recipe

slots.label: Orange Chicken
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 35 mins
Crispy chicken in a sticky orange glaze, lighter than takeout.
523 kcal · 44g protein · 58g carbs · 12g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 1/2 lb chicken breast, cubed
• 1/4 cup cornstarch
• 2 tbsp olive oil
• 1/2 cup orange juice
• 3 tbsp soy sauce
• 2 tbsp honey
• 2 garlic cloves
• 3 cups cooked rice
• 2 green onions

Steps:
1. Toss the chicken in cornstarch with a pinch of salt.
2. Pan-fry in the oil over medium-high in batches until golden, 6–7 minutes.
3. Simmer the orange juice, soy sauce, honey and garlic 3 minutes until syrupy.
4. Toss the chicken in the sauce; serve over rice with green onions.

slots.label: Overnight Oats Five-Day Prep
slots.info:
EZ Prep · Meal Prep • 10 mins
Five jars of oats in ten minutes.
359 kcal · 18g protein · 54g carbs · 9g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 1/2 cups rolled oats
• 2 1/2 cups milk
• 1 1/4 cups plain Greek yogurt
• 5 tbsp chia seeds
• 5 tsp honey
• 2 1/2 cups mixed berries

Steps:
1. Line up 5 jars.
2. Add 1/2 cup oats, 1/2 cup milk, 1/4 cup yogurt, 1 tbsp chia and 1 tsp honey to each. Stir.
3. Top each with berries, cover, and refrigerate up to 5 days.

slots.label: Overnight Oats, Peanut Butter Banana
slots.info:
Breakfast · Meal Prep • 5 mins
Creamy no-cook oats you make the night before.
468 kcal · 22g protein · 62g carbs · 17g fat

Ingredients:
• 1/2 cup rolled oats
• 1/2 cup milk
• 1/4 cup plain Greek yogurt
• 1 tbsp chia seeds
• 1 tbsp peanut butter
• 1/2 banana, sliced
• 1 tsp honey

Steps:
1. Stir the oats, milk, yogurt, chia seeds and honey together in a jar.
2. Swirl in the peanut butter and top with banana.
3. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight.
4. Eat cold or microwave 1 minute.
slots.q: Overnight Oats, Peanut Butter Banana recipe

slots.label: Overnight Protein Proats
slots.info:
EZ Prep · High Protein • EZ Prep
Grab-and-go morning oats infused with whey.
320 kcal · 30g protein · 35g carbs · 7g fat

Ingredients:
• 1/2 cup rolled oats
• 1 scoop vanilla protein powder
• 1/2 cup almond milk
• 1 tbsp chia seeds

Steps:
1. Whisk the protein powder into the almond milk until there are no lumps.
2. Stir in the oats and chia seeds.
3. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight.
4. Stir and eat cold, adding a splash more milk if it's too thick.

slots.label: PB&J Smoothie
slots.info:
Breakfast · No Cook • 5 mins
The lunchbox classic in a glass.
359 kcal · 26g protein · 37g carbs · 14g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 cup frozen strawberries
• 1 tbsp peanut butter
• 1/2 cup plain Greek yogurt
• 1 cup milk
• 1 tsp honey

Steps:
1. Blend everything until smooth.
2. Taste and add more honey if needed.

slots.label: Pan-Seared Chicken with Pan Gravy
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 30 mins
Crispy-skinned style chicken with mashed potatoes and gravy.
496 kcal · 40g protein · 42g carbs · 18g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 1/2 lb chicken thighs
• 2 lb potatoes
• 1/2 cup milk
• 2 tbsp butter
• 1 tbsp all-purpose flour
• 1 cup chicken broth

Steps:
1. Boil the potatoes 15 minutes, drain, and mash with milk, 1 tbsp butter, salt and pepper.
2. Season and sear the chicken 6 minutes per side until 175°F; remove.
3. Whisk the flour into the pan drippings with remaining butter, then the broth. Simmer 3 minutes.
4. Serve the chicken over potatoes with gravy.
slots.q: Pan-Seared Chicken with Pan Gravy recipe

slots.label: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
slots.info:
Breakfast · Vegetarian • 5 mins
Simple, filling and kid-approved.
474 kcal · 18g protein · 66g carbs · 19g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 slices whole wheat bread
• 2 tbsp peanut butter
• 1 banana, sliced
• 1 tsp honey
• 1/2 tsp cinnamon

Steps:
1. Toast the bread.
2. Spread with peanut butter and top with banana slices.
3. Drizzle with honey and sprinkle cinnamon.

slots.label: Peanut Butter Chia Pudding
slots.info:
Breakfast · Vegetarian • 5 mins
Thick chia pudding with peanut butter and banana.
326 kcal · 10g protein · 35g carbs · 19g fat

Ingredients:
• 1/3 cup chia seeds
• 1 1/4 cups almond milk
• 2 tbsp peanut butter
• 1 tbsp maple syrup
• 1 banana, sliced

Steps:
1. Whisk the almond milk, peanut butter and maple syrup until smooth.
2. Stir in the chia seeds; wait 5 minutes and stir again.
3. Refrigerate at least 3 hours. Top with banana.

slots.label: Peanut Butter Energy Bites
slots.info:
Snack · Meal Prep • 15 mins
No-bake oat balls with peanut butter, honey and chocolate chips.
233 kcal · 7g protein · 29g carbs · 11g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 1/2 cups rolled oats
• 1/2 cup peanut butter
• 1/3 cup honey
• 1/4 cup mini chocolate chips
• 2 tbsp chia seeds
• 1 tsp vanilla extract

Steps:
1. Stir everything together in a bowl until evenly mixed.
2. Chill 15 minutes so it's easier to roll.
3. Roll into 16 balls (two per serving). Keep in the fridge up to a week.

slots.label: Peanut Chicken Noodle Prep
slots.info:
EZ Prep · High Protein • 25 mins
Cold-friendly noodles with peanut sauce and veggies.
465 kcal · 35g protein · 55g carbs · 12g fat

Ingredients:
• 8 oz spaghetti
• 2 cups shredded chicken
• 1/4 cup peanut butter
• 3 tbsp soy sauce
• 1 tbsp honey
• 1 tbsp rice vinegar
• 2 cups coleslaw mix
• 1 bell pepper

Steps:
1. Cook the noodles and rinse cold.
2. Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, honey, vinegar and 3 tbsp warm water.
3. Toss everything together and portion into 4 containers.

slots.label: Penne alla Vodka (No Vodka)
slots.info:
Dinner · Vegetarian • 25 mins
Creamy tomato sauce clinging to penne.
520 kcal · 17g protein · 74g carbs · 18g fat

Ingredients:
• 12 oz penne
• 1 tbsp butter
• 3 garlic cloves
• 2 tbsp tomato paste
• 1 can crushed tomatoes
• 1/2 cup heavy cream
• 1/3 cup parmesan
• 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes

Steps:
1. Cook the pasta.
2. Melt the butter, cook garlic and red pepper 30 seconds, then the tomato paste 2 minutes.
3. Add the tomatoes and simmer 8 minutes; stir in the cream and parmesan.
4. Toss with the pasta.

slots.label: Pesto Chicken & Veggie Sheet Pan
slots.info:
EZ Prep · High Protein • 30 mins
Chicken, zucchini and tomatoes roasted with pesto.
462 kcal · 43g protein · 34g carbs · 16g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 1/2 lb chicken breast, cubed
• 2 zucchini, chopped
• 1 1/2 cups cherry tomatoes
• 1/4 cup pesto
• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 2 cups cooked brown rice

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 425°F.
2. Toss the chicken and vegetables with oil and pesto.
3. Roast 20 minutes.
4. Divide over brown rice.
slots.q: Pesto Chicken & Veggie Sheet Pan recipe

slots.label: Pesto Chicken Pasta
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 25 mins
Basil pesto, chicken and cherry tomatoes over penne.
587 kcal · 40g protein · 67g carbs · 17g fat

Ingredients:
• 12 oz penne
• 1 lb chicken breast, cubed
• 1/3 cup pesto
• 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved
• 1/4 cup parmesan
• 1 tsp olive oil

Steps:
1. Cook the pasta; reserve 1/2 cup water.
2. Cook the chicken in the oil 7 minutes.
3. Toss the pasta with pesto, chicken, tomatoes and a splash of pasta water. Top with parmesan.

slots.label: Pesto Pasta Salad
slots.info:
Lunch · Vegetarian • 20 mins
Cold pasta salad with mozzarella pearls, tomatoes and spinach.
398 kcal · 17g protein · 47g carbs · 16g fat

Ingredients:
• 8 oz rotini
• 1/3 cup pesto
• 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved
• 4 oz mozzarella
• 2 cups baby spinach
• 2 tbsp parmesan

Steps:
1. Cook the pasta, rinse under cold water and drain well.
2. Toss with pesto.
3. Fold in tomatoes, mozzarella and spinach. Top with parmesan.
4. Keeps 4 days in the fridge.

slots.label: Philly Cheesesteak Sandwiches
slots.info:
Lunch · High Protein • 25 mins
Thin-sliced steak with peppers, onions and provolone.
572 kcal · 41g protein · 36g carbs · 28g fat

Ingredients:
• 10 oz sirloin steak, thinly sliced
• 1 bell pepper, sliced
• 1 onion, sliced
• 2 slices provolone
• 2 hoagie rolls
• 1 tbsp olive oil

Steps:
1. Sauté the pepper and onion in half the oil 8 minutes until soft; remove.
2. Sear the steak in the remaining oil 2–3 minutes. Return the veggies.
3. Divide into two piles, top with provolone and cover to melt.
4. Scoop into toasted rolls.

slots.label: Philly Cheesesteak Stuffed Peppers
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 35 mins
Steak, onions and provolone baked inside peppers.
362 kcal · 32g protein · 12g carbs · 21g fat

Ingredients:
• 4 bell peppers
• 1 lb sirloin steak, thinly sliced
• 1 onion, sliced
• 8 oz mushrooms
• 4 slices provolone
• 1 tbsp olive oil

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 400°F. Halve the peppers and bake 10 minutes.
2. Sauté the onion and mushrooms 6 minutes; add the steak and cook 3 minutes.
3. Line peppers with half a provolone slice, fill, and top with the rest.
4. Bake 10 minutes until melted.

slots.label: Pizza Quesadillas
slots.info:
Lunch · Comfort Food • 15 mins
Pepperoni-pizza flavor folded in a tortilla.
381 kcal · 25g protein · 28g carbs · 19g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 flour tortillas
• 1 cup mozzarella
• 1/4 cup marinara
• 2 oz turkey pepperoni
• 1/2 tsp italian seasoning

Steps:
1. Spread marinara on half of each tortilla.
2. Add mozzarella, pepperoni and Italian seasoning; fold.
3. Cook in a dry skillet 2–3 minutes per side until crisp.
4. Cut into wedges with extra marinara for dipping.

slots.label: Popcorn with Parmesan & Herbs
slots.info:
Snack · Vegetarian • 10 mins
Savory popcorn that tastes buttery without much butter.
215 kcal · 8g protein · 25g carbs · 10g fat

Ingredients:
• 8 cups popcorn
• 1 tbsp butter, melted
• 3 tbsp parmesan
• 1 tsp italian seasoning

Steps:
1. Toss the popcorn with butter.
2. Sprinkle with parmesan, Italian seasoning and salt; toss again.

slots.label: Pork Chops with Apples
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 30 mins
Golden pork chops with sweet, buttery sautéed apples.
408 kcal · 38g protein · 35g carbs · 15g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 pork chops
• 2 apples, sliced
• 1 tbsp butter
• 1 tsp olive oil
• 1 tsp brown sugar
• 1/2 tsp cinnamon
• 1/2 tsp thyme
• 2 cups green beans

Steps:
1. Season the chops and sear in the oil 4–5 minutes per side until 145°F. Rest.
2. In the same pan, melt the butter and cook the apples with brown sugar, cinnamon and thyme 6 minutes.
3. Steam the green beans.
4. Serve the chops with apples and beans.

slots.label: Pretzel & Cheese Snack Plate
slots.info:
Snack · Balanced • 5 mins
Salty-crunchy snack board.
299 kcal · 11g protein · 38g carbs · 12g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 1/2 cups pretzels
• 2 oz cheddar, sliced
• 1 cup grapes
• 2 tbsp mustard

Steps:
1. Arrange pretzels, cheese and grapes on a plate.
2. Serve with mustard for dipping.

slots.label: Protein Breakfast Burrito Freezer Pack
slots.info:
EZ Prep · High Protein • 30 mins
Eight burritos for busy mornings.
426 kcal · 30g protein · 26g carbs · 22g fat

Ingredients:
• 12 large eggs
• 1 lb ground turkey
• 1 tbsp taco seasoning
• 1 1/2 cups shredded cheddar
• 1 cup salsa
• 8 flour tortillas

Steps:
1. Brown the turkey with taco seasoning.
2. Scramble the eggs until just set.
3. Fill tortillas with eggs, turkey, cheese and salsa; roll tightly.
4. Wrap in foil and freeze. Microwave 2 minutes from frozen.
slots.q: Protein Breakfast Burrito Freezer Pack recipe

slots.label: Protein Pancakes
slots.info:
Breakfast · High Protein • 15 mins
Banana-oat pancakes with whey — fluffy and 30g+ protein per plate.
426 kcal · 31g protein · 59g carbs · 9g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 cup rolled oats
• 1 scoop vanilla protein powder
• 1 banana
• 2 large eggs
• 1/2 cup plain Greek yogurt
• 1 tsp baking powder
• 1/2 tsp cinnamon
• 2 tbsp maple syrup

Steps:
1. Blend the oats into a flour, then add the protein powder, banana, eggs, yogurt, baking powder and cinnamon. Blend until smooth.
2. Let the batter rest 3 minutes to thicken.
3. Cook 1/4-cup scoops on a greased nonstick pan over medium-low, about 2 minutes per side.
4. Serve with maple syrup and berries if you like.

slots.label: Protein Power Scramble
slots.info:
Breakfast · High Protein • 5 mins
Whole eggs and liquid egg whites scramble.
240 kcal · 28g protein · 3g carbs · 12g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 whole eggs
• 1/2 cup liquid egg whites
• Handful of spinach

Steps:
1. Whisk the whole eggs and egg whites with a pinch of salt and pepper.
2. Wilt the spinach in a greased nonstick skillet over medium heat, about 1 minute.
3. Pour in the eggs and stir slowly until softly set, 2–3 minutes.
4. Serve right away, with toast or salsa if you like.

slots.label: Protein Yogurt Bark
slots.info:
Snack · Meal Prep • 10 mins
Frozen yogurt bark with berries and chocolate.
119 kcal · 13g protein · 14g carbs · 2g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 cups plain Greek yogurt
• 1 scoop vanilla protein powder
• 2 tbsp honey
• 1 cup mixed berries
• 2 tbsp mini chocolate chips

Steps:
1. Whisk the yogurt, protein powder and honey.
2. Spread 1/2 inch thick on a parchment-lined sheet pan.
3. Scatter berries and chocolate chips on top.
4. Freeze 3 hours, then break into pieces. Keep frozen.

slots.id: recipe:Rice Cakes with Peanut Butter & Banana
slots.label: Rice Cakes with Peanut Butter & Banana
slots.info:
Snack · Balanced • 5 mins
Crunchy, sweet and quick.

slots.label: Salisbury Steak
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 35 mins
Seasoned beef patties in mushroom-onion gravy.

Ingredients:
• 1 1/4 lb lean ground beef
• 1/3 cup panko
• 1 large egg
• 1 tsp worcestershire
• 8 oz mushrooms, sliced
• 1 onion, sliced
• 1 1/2 cups beef broth
• 1 tbsp cornstarch
• 1 1/2 lb potatoes

Steps:
1. Boil and mash the potatoes.
2. Mix the beef, panko, egg and Worcestershire; shape 4 oval patties and brown 3 minutes per side. Remove.
3. Cook mushrooms and onion 7 minutes. Add broth mixed with cornstarch; simmer until thick.
4. Return patties and simmer 8 minutes. Serve with mashed potatoes.

slots.label: Salmon Pesto Pasta
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 25 mins
Flaked salmon, pesto and peas tossed with linguine.

Ingredients:
• 1 lb salmon fillet
• 8 oz linguine
• 1/4 cup pesto
• 1 cup frozen peas
• 1 lemon

Steps:
1. Bake the salmon at 400°F for 12 minutes; flake.
2. Cook the pasta, adding peas for the last 2 minutes.
3. Toss with pesto, lemon juice and salmon.

slots.label: Salmon Rice Bowls
slots.info:
Lunch · High Protein • 25 mins
Flaky salmon, rice, cucumber and avocado with spicy mayo.
764 kcal · 37g protein · 81g carbs · 30g fat

Ingredients:
• 10 oz salmon fillet
• 1 cup jasmine rice
• 1/2 cucumber, diced
• 1/2 avocado
• 1 tbsp soy sauce
• 1 tbsp mayo
• 1 tsp sriracha
• 1 tsp sesame seeds

Steps:
1. Cook the rice.
2. Brush the salmon with soy sauce and bake at 400°F for 12 minutes; flake.
3. Mix the mayo and sriracha.
4. Build bowls with rice, salmon, cucumber and avocado; drizzle spicy mayo and sprinkle sesame seeds.

slots.label: Sausage, Peppers & Onions
slots.info:
Dinner · Comfort Food • 30 mins
Italian-style skillet with crusty rolls.
541 kcal · 23g protein · 39g carbs · 32g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 lb italian sausage
• 2 bell peppers, sliced
• 1 onion, sliced
• 2 garlic cloves
• 1/2 cup marinara
• 4 hoagie rolls

Steps:
1. Brown the sausages whole, 8 minutes; slice.
2. Cook the peppers and onion in the drippings 8 minutes until soft.
3. Add garlic, marinara and the sausage; simmer 5 minutes.
4. Serve in toasted rolls.

slots.label: Sesame Ginger Tofu Stir-Fry
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 30 mins
Crispy tofu with vegetables in a sesame-ginger sauce.
469 kcal · 30g protein · 53g carbs · 17g fat

Ingredients:
• 14 oz extra-firm tofu, cubed
• 2 tbsp cornstarch
• 3 cups stir-fry vegetables
• 3 tbsp soy sauce
• 1 tbsp honey
• 1 tbsp sesame oil
• 1 tsp fresh ginger
• 2 cups cooked rice

Steps:
1. Pat the tofu dry and toss with cornstarch.
2. Pan-fry in the sesame oil 8–10 minutes until crisp on all sides.
3. Add vegetables and cook 4 minutes.
4. Add soy sauce, honey and ginger; toss 1 minute. Serve over rice.

slots.label: Sesame Noodle Salad
slots.info:
Lunch · Vegetarian • 20 mins
Cold noodles with crunchy veggies in sesame-peanut sauce.

Ingredients:
• 8 oz spaghetti
• 3 tbsp soy sauce
• 2 tbsp peanut butter
• 1 tbsp sesame oil
• 1 tbsp rice vinegar
• 1 tbsp honey
• 1 bell pepper, sliced
• 1 cucumber, sliced
• 1 cup edamame
• 2 green onions

Steps:
1. Cook the spaghetti, rinse cold and drain.
2. Whisk the soy sauce, peanut butter, sesame oil, vinegar, honey and 2 tbsp hot water.
3. Toss the noodles with sauce, vegetables and edamame. Top with green onions.

slots.label: Shakshuka
slots.info:
Breakfast · Vegetarian • 30 mins
Eggs poached in a spiced tomato-pepper sauce. Great with crusty bread.
354 kcal · 21g protein · 30g carbs · 17g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 can crushed tomatoes
• 1 bell pepper, diced
• 1 onion, diced
• 3 garlic cloves, minced
• 6 large eggs
• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 1 tsp cumin
• 1 tsp smoked paprika
• 2 tbsp feta
• 3 slices sourdough

Steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large skillet. Cook the onion and pepper 6 minutes until soft.
2. Add the garlic, cumin and paprika for 1 minute, then the tomatoes. Simmer 10 minutes.
3. Make six wells and crack in the eggs. Cover and simmer 6–8 minutes until whites are set.
4. Sprinkle with feta and serve with toasted bread.

slots.label: Sheet-Pan Breakfast Burritos
slots.info:
Breakfast · Meal Prep • 35 mins
Freezer-friendly burritos stuffed with eggs, sausage, potatoes and cheese.
548 kcal · 29g protein · 35g carbs · 33g fat

Ingredients:
• 10 large eggs
• 12 oz breakfast sausage
• 2 cups frozen hash browns
• 1 cup shredded cheddar
• 6 flour tortillas
• 1/2 cup salsa
• Salt and pepper

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 400°F. Spread the hash browns on a lined sheet pan, season, and bake 15 minutes.
2. Meanwhile brown the sausage in a skillet, breaking it up, about 8 minutes. Remove to a bowl.
3. Scramble the eggs in the same skillet until just set; season with salt and pepper.
4. Divide potatoes, sausage, eggs, cheese and salsa among the tortillas. Fold in the sides and roll tightly.
5. Eat right away, or wrap each in foil and freeze. Reheat from frozen: 2 minutes in the microwave, turning once.

slots.label: Sheet-Pan Chicken Fajitas
slots.info:

Everything roasts together — just add tortillas.

Ingredients:
• 1 1/2 lb chicken breast, sliced
• 3 bell peppers, sliced
• 1 onion, sliced
• 2 tbsp olive oil

• 1/2 cup sour cream
• 1 lime

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 425°F.
2. Toss the chicken, peppers and onion with oil and taco seasoning on a sheet pan.
3. Roast 20 minutes, then broil 2 minutes for char.
4. Squeeze lime over and serve in warm tortillas with sour cream.

slots.label: Sheet-Pan Sausage & Veggies

• 1 tsp italian seasoning

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 425°F.
2. Roast the potatoes with half the oil 10 minutes.
3. Add everything else, toss, and roast 18 minutes more.

slots.label: Shrimp Scampi

• 12 oz shrimp
• 6 oz linguine

• 1 tbsp olive oil

• 1 lemon

• 2 tbsp parsley

Steps:
1. Cook the linguine; reserve 1/2 cup water.
2. Cook the garlic and red pepper in the butter and oil 1 minute.
3. Add the shrimp and cook 2 minutes per side.
4. Add lemon juice, pasta and a splash of pasta water; toss. Finish with parsley.

slots.label: Shrimp Tacos with Lime Slaw
slots.info:

• 12 oz shrimp
• 6 corn tortillas
• 2 cups coleslaw mix
• 2 tbsp sour cream

• 1 tsp olive oil
• 1/4 avocado

Steps:
1. Toss the slaw with sour cream, half the lime juice and a pinch of salt.

slots.label: Slow Cooker Pot Roast

• 3 lb sirloin

1. Season and sear the roast on all sides (optional but tasty).

1. Put the chicken in the slow cooker and cover with salsa and seasoning.

slots.label: Smoked Salmon Bagel

1. Toast the bagels.

1. Hard-boil the eggs; cool and peel.

1. Stir the ranch and salsa together for the dressing.

1. Heat the oven to 425°F.

4. Portion into 4 containers.

Steps:
1. Rub the steak with taco seasoning; sear 4–5 minutes per side. Rest and slice thin.

3. Build bowls with rice, steak, veggies, guacamole and salsa.

slots.info:

• 10 oz sirloin steak
• 5 cups mixed greens
• 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes
• 1/4 red onion, sliced

Steps:
1. Season the steak and sear 4 minutes per side. Rest 5 minutes and slice thin.
2. Whisk the balsamic and oil with salt and pepper.

Ingredients:
• 10 oz sirloin steak
• 4 large eggs

• 1 tsp butter
• 1 cup cherry tomatoes
• Salt and pepper

Steps:
1. Pat the steak dry and season well. Sear in the oil over high heat 3–4 minutes per side for medium-rare.
2. Rest the steak 5 minutes while you blister the tomatoes in the same pan.
3. Fry the eggs in the butter.
4. Slice the steak against the grain and serve with eggs and tomatoes.

slots.info:

Ingredients:
• 12 oz flank steak

• 2 tbsp olive oil

Steps:
1. Roast the halved potatoes at 425°F with a little oil, 25 minutes.
2. Chop the parsley and garlic; mix with remaining oil, vinegar, red pepper and salt.
3. Sear the steak 4–5 minutes per side. Rest and slice against the grain.
4. Spoon chimichurri over the steak.

slots.label: Steel-Cut Style Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal

Steps:
1. Simmer the milk, apple and cinnamon for 3 minutes.
2. Stir in the oats and cook 5 minutes, stirring, until creamy.
3. Sweeten with maple syrup and top with walnuts.

slots.label: Strawberry Banana Smoothie
slots.info:

Ingredients:

Steps:
1. Blend everything until smooth.
2. Serve right away.

Ingredients:
• 1/2 cup rolled oats
• 1/2 cup milk
• 1/4 cup plain Greek yogurt
• 1 tbsp cream cheese

• 1 tsp honey
• 1/2 tsp vanilla extract

Steps:
1. Whisk the cream cheese with the yogurt, honey and vanilla until smooth.
2. Stir in the oats and milk.
3. Top with strawberries, cover and chill overnight.

Ingredients:
• 4 bell peppers
• 1 lb lean ground beef

• 1 can diced tomatoes
• 1 tsp italian seasoning

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 375°F. Halve the peppers and remove seeds.

3. Fill the peppers, cover with foil, and bake 25 minutes.
4. Top with mozzarella and bake uncovered 10 minutes.

Ingredients:
• 1 sweet potato, diced
• 1/2 bell pepper, diced
• 1/2 onion, diced
• 1/2 cup black beans

• 1 tsp chili powder

Steps:
1. Cook the sweet potato in the oil, covered, over medium for 8 minutes.
2. Uncover, add pepper, onion and chili powder; cook 6 minutes until browned.
3. Stir in the beans to warm.
4. Make four wells, add the eggs, cover and cook 4–5 minutes.

• 1 lb chicken thighs, cubed

• 3 cups broccoli florets

• 2 green onions, sliced

Steps:
1. Cook the rice.
2. Brown the chicken in the oil over medium-high 6–7 minutes.

Ingredients:
• 2 salmon fillets
• 1 sweet potato, cubed
• 2 cups broccoli florets
• 3 tbsp teriyaki sauce

• 1 tsp sesame seeds

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 425°F. Roast the sweet potato in half the oil 12 minutes.
2. Add the broccoli (tossed in remaining oil) and salmon to the pan; brush salmon with teriyaki.

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 400°F.

• 3 tbsp mayo
• 1 celery stalk, diced
• 1 tsp dijon mustard
• 4 slices sourdough
• 2 slices cheddar
• 1 tbsp butter

Steps:
1. Mix the tuna, mayo, celery, mustard, salt and pepper.
2. Butter the outside of each bread slice.
3. Build sandwiches with tuna and cheese.
4. Cook in a skillet over medium 3–4 minutes per side until golden and melted.

slots.label: Tuna Pasta Salad
slots.info:
EZ Prep · High Protein • 20 mins
Creamy, crunchy and great cold.
437 kcal · 36g protein · 50g carbs · 10g fat

Ingredients:
• 8 oz rotini
• 3 cans tuna
• 1/2 cup plain Greek yogurt
• 3 tbsp mayo
• 1 cup frozen peas, thawed
• 2 celery stalks, diced
• 1 tbsp lemon juice

Steps:
1. Cook the pasta, rinse cold and drain.
2. Mix the yogurt, mayo, lemon, salt and pepper.
3. Fold in tuna, peas, celery and pasta. Keeps 3 days.

slots.label: Tuna Salad Cucumber Boats
slots.info:
EZ Prep · High Protein • EZ Prep
Crisp cucumber halves stuffed with high-protein tuna salad.
220 kcal · 30g protein · 6g carbs · 4g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 can tuna in water, drained
• 1 tbsp Greek yogurt
• 1 cucumber
• Salt

Steps:
1. Halve the cucumber lengthwise and scoop out the seeds with a spoon.
2. Mix the tuna with Greek yogurt, salt, pepper and a squeeze of lemon if you have it.
3. Fill the cucumber halves and cut into boats.

slots.label: Tuna Salad Stuffed Avocados
slots.info:
Lunch · High Protein • 10 mins
Light, creamy tuna salad scooped into avocado halves.
445 kcal · 37g protein · 15g carbs · 28g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 cans tuna, drained
• 3 tbsp plain Greek yogurt
• 1 tbsp mayo
• 1 celery stalk, diced
• 1 tbsp lemon juice
• 2 avocados

Steps:
1. Mix the tuna, yogurt, mayo, celery, lemon, salt and pepper.
2. Halve and pit the avocados.
3. Pile the tuna into the avocado halves.

slots.label: Turkey & Avocado Wrap
slots.info:
Lunch · High Protein • 5 mins
Easy, fresh, and filling.
396 kcal · 30g protein · 31g carbs · 18g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 flour tortillas
• 4 oz deli turkey
• 1/4 avocado, mashed
• 1 slice swiss cheese
• 1 cup spinach
• 1 tbsp mustard

Steps:
1. Spread the avocado and mustard over the tortilla.
2. Layer cheese, turkey and spinach.
3. Roll tightly and cut in half.

slots.label: Turkey & Cheese Roll-Ups
slots.info:
Snack · Balanced • 5 mins
Easy, low-carb protein snack.
229 kcal · 23g protein · 8g carbs · 12g fat

Ingredients:
• 6 oz deli turkey
• 3 slices swiss cheese
• 1 cucumber, cut in sticks
• 1 tbsp mustard

Steps:
1. Cut each cheese slice in half.
2. Lay out the turkey, spread a little mustard, add cheese and a cucumber stick.
3. Roll up tightly.

slots.label: Turkey Club Sandwich
slots.info:
Lunch · High Protein • 10 mins
Triple-decker deli classic with bacon, lettuce and tomato.
732 kcal · 53g protein · 84g carbs · 25g fat

Ingredients:
• 6 slices whole wheat bread
• 8 oz deli turkey
• 4 slices bacon, cooked
• 4 lettuce leaves
• 1 tomato, sliced
• 2 tbsp mayo

Steps:
1. Toast the bread.
2. Spread mayo on each slice.
3. Layer turkey, lettuce and tomato on one slice, add a second slice, then bacon, more lettuce and the top slice.
4. Secure with toothpicks and cut into quarters.

slots.label: Turkey Meatball Meal Prep
slots.info:
EZ Prep · High Protein • 35 mins
Baked meatballs, roasted veggies and quinoa.
503 kcal · 47g protein · 32g carbs · 21g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 lb ground turkey
• 1/2 cup panko
• 2 large eggs
• 1/3 cup parmesan
• 1 tsp italian seasoning
• 1 cup quinoa
• 4 cups broccoli florets

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 400°F.
2. Mix turkey, panko, eggs, parmesan and seasoning; roll 25 meatballs and bake 15 minutes.
3. Roast the broccoli alongside for 15 minutes.
4. Cook the quinoa and divide everything into 5 containers.

slots.label: Turkey Meatballs & Marinara
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 35 mins
Tender turkey meatballs baked, then simmered in sauce.
627 kcal · 47g protein · 62g carbs · 20g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 1/2 lb ground turkey
• 1/2 cup panko
• 1 large egg
• 1/4 cup parmesan
• 2 garlic cloves
• 1 tsp italian seasoning
• 1 jar marinara
• 8 oz spaghetti

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 400°F.
2. Mix the turkey, panko, egg, parmesan, garlic, Italian seasoning and salt. Roll 20 meatballs.
3. Bake on a lined sheet 15 minutes.
4. Simmer the meatballs in marinara 10 minutes. Serve over spaghetti.

slots.label: Turkey Sausage Breakfast Sandwich
slots.info:
Breakfast · High Protein • 15 mins
Homemade turkey patties on English muffins.
458 kcal · 38g protein · 27g carbs · 22g fat

Ingredients:
• 8 oz ground turkey
• 1/2 tsp sage
• 1/2 tsp garlic powder
• 2 english muffins
• 2 large eggs
• 2 slices cheddar

Steps:
1. Mix the turkey with sage, garlic powder, salt and pepper. Shape into 2 thin patties.
2. Cook the patties 4 minutes per side over medium until 165°F inside.
3. Fry the eggs in the same pan.
4. Toast the muffins and stack patty, egg and cheese.

slots.label: Turkey Taco Lettuce Cups
slots.info:
Lunch · High Protein • 20 mins
Taco night flavor, lighter.
390 kcal · 37g protein · 11g carbs · 23g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 lb ground turkey
• 1 tbsp taco seasoning
• 1/2 cup salsa
• 1 head butter lettuce
• 1/2 cup shredded cheddar
• 1/4 cup sour cream

Steps:
1. Brown the turkey, breaking it up, 7 minutes.
2. Stir in taco seasoning and 1/4 cup water; simmer 3 minutes.
3. Spoon into lettuce cups and top with salsa, cheese and sour cream.

slots.label: Turkey Taco Meal Prep
slots.info:
EZ Prep · High Protein • 30 mins
Taco-seasoned turkey with rice, beans and corn.
647 kcal · 45g protein · 82g carbs · 15g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 1/2 lb ground turkey
• 2 tbsp taco seasoning
• 1 1/2 cups rice
• 1 can black beans
• 1 cup corn
• 1 cup salsa

Steps:
1. Cook the rice.
2. Brown the turkey with taco seasoning and a splash of water.
3. Warm the beans and corn.
4. Divide into 4 containers and top with salsa when reheating.

slots.label: Turkey Taco Skillet with Rice
slots.info:
Dinner · High Protein • 30 mins
One-pan rice, beans and seasoned turkey topped with cheese.
568 kcal · 39g protein · 58g carbs · 19g fat

Ingredients:
• 1 lb ground turkey
• 1 cup rice
• 1 can black beans, drained
• 1 cup salsa
• 2 cups chicken broth
• 1 tbsp taco seasoning
• 1 cup shredded cheddar

Steps:
1. Brown the turkey with taco seasoning.
2. Stir in the rice, salsa and broth. Cover and simmer 18 minutes.
3. Stir in the beans, top with cheese, and cover 2 minutes to melt.
slots.q: Turkey Taco Skillet with Rice recipe

slots.label: Vegetable Lo Mein
slots.info:
Dinner · Vegetarian • 25 mins
Takeout-style noodles loaded with veggies.
436 kcal · 18g protein · 68g carbs · 9g fat

Ingredients:
• 8 oz lo mein noodles
• 3 cups stir-fry vegetables
• 3 tbsp soy sauce
• 1 tbsp hoisin
• 1 tbsp sesame oil
• 2 garlic cloves
• 2 large eggs

Steps:
1. Cook the noodles and drain.
2. Stir-fry the garlic and vegetables in the sesame oil 4 minutes.
3. Scramble the eggs in the pan.
4. Add noodles, soy sauce and hoisin; toss 2 minutes.

slots.label: Veggie Frittata
slots.info:
Breakfast · Vegetarian • 30 mins
Zucchini, peppers and parmesan baked into a big frittata.
248 kcal · 17g protein · 8g carbs · 16g fat

Ingredients:
• 8 large eggs
• 1/3 cup milk
• 1 zucchini, diced
• 1 bell pepper, diced
• 1/2 onion, diced
• 1/3 cup parmesan
• 1 tbsp olive oil

Steps:
1. Heat the oven to 375°F.
2. Sauté the vegetables in the oil in an oven-safe skillet for 6 minutes.
3. Whisk the eggs, milk, parmesan, salt and pepper and pour over.
4. Cook on the stove 2 minutes, then bake 15 minutes until set. Slice into wedges.

slots.label: Veggie Hummus Wraps
slots.info:
Lunch · Vegetarian • 10 mins
Crunchy veggies and creamy hummus.
300 kcal · 11g protein · 40g carbs · 12g fat

Ingredients:
• 2 flour tortillas
• 1/2 cup hummus
• 1 cup spinach
• 1/2 cucumber, sliced
• 1 carrot, shredded
• 1/2 bell pepper, sliced
• 2 tbsp feta

Steps:
1. Spread hummus over each tortilla.
2. Layer the vegetables and feta.
3. Roll tightly and slice in half.
